ecb0dded.title: Data Architect
ecb0dded.location: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Mumbai (All Areas), India
ecb0dded.description:
**Job Description: Data ArchitectRole Overview  
  

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining, driving, and executing the end-to-end data architecture and technical vision across complex enterprise solutions, projects, and transformation programs.

In this role, you will ensure organizational data is structured, integrated, governed, secured, and optimized to power business applications, advanced analytics, real-time reporting, and cutting-edge AI/ML systems. You will act as the key bridge between business stakeholders and technical execution teams—working closely with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, DevOps, Security, Analytics, and Business Leaders.

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise Data Architecture & Strategy

* Design and execute end-to-end data architectures aligned with strategic business goals and complex solution requirements.
* Develop scalable data models (conceptual, logical, physical), data flows, schemas, and integration blueprints.
* Formulate robust data storage and persistence strategies across transactional (OLTP), analytical (OLAP), operational, and reporting workloads.
* Evaluate and select cloud-native, relational, NoSQL, distributed, and hybrid data platform technologies to ensure maximum performance, scalability, and maintainability.

2. Data Pipeline & Integration Engineering

* Design robust, fault-tolerant integration patterns—including RESTful APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, event-driven architectures, real-time streaming, and batch processing.
* Define standards for data movement, transformation, synchronization, consistency, and dependency management.
* Architect seamless integration bridges connecting modern cloud platforms with legacy enterprise systems.

3. AI & Advanced Analytics Architecture

* Assess data readiness, quality, and structure to support enterprise AI/ML initiatives and advanced analytics.
* Build modern AI data foundation architectures incorporating vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search, and unstructured data ingestion patterns.
* Establish lineage, governance, and ethical safeguards around enterprise data used for training and running AI systems.

4. Governance, Security & Quality Management

* Establish technical controls, privacy policies, and data governance frameworks aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Define access controls, encryption, retention policies, and security mechanisms for sensitive and regulated data.
* Drive automated data quality validation frameworks ensuring data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and end-to-end lineage tracking.

5. Technical Leadership & Execution Delivery

* Own the technical lifecycle of data solutions from early architecture through implementation and production deployment.
* Provide active technical oversight to engineering teams, conducting code and architecture reviews for data pipelines, queries, and integration solutions.
* Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks, resolve high-severity data issues, and optimize production query/workload efficiency.

6. Presales & Strategic Solutioning

* Partner with growth teams to deliver data architecture inputs for client RFPs, proposals, and solution blueprints.
* Conduct technical feasibility studies, data migration evaluations, sizing estimation, and risk assessments for new projects.
* Lead high-impact client workshops, technical presentations, and architecture alignment sessions.

Key Technical Competencies

* Data Modeling & Architecture: Conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling; Dimensional modeling; Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Data Lakehouses.
* Database & Cloud Platforms: Deep familiarity with modern cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks), Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL), and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) systems.
* Integration & Streaming: ETL/ELT pipeline tools, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ), streaming, and API management.
* AI & Next-Gen Patterns: Vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant), RAG data pipelines, LLM fine-tuning data pipelines, and semantic frameworks.
* Governance & Security: Data lineage, cataloging (e.g., Collibra, Alation), RBAC/ABAC security, and regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA).
* Performance Optimization: Query tuning, data partition strategies, automated testing, and scalable data pipeline optimization.

Behavioral Skills & Core Mindset

* Strategic Business Alignment: Ability to bridge technical data architectures with tangible business outcomes and strategic priorities.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to align engineering, security, analytics, and non-technical business stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving & Mentorship: Strong analytical capability to resolve ambiguous technical hurdles and guide engineering teams toward execution excellence.
* Technical Communication: Skill in simplifying and presenting complex data concepts to C-suite leaders and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications & Experience

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 10–15+ years of total experience in software/data engineering, with a strong focus on enterprise data architecture.
* Cloud & Modern Stack: Proven hands-on track record building enterprise data architectures on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Transformation Impact: Demonstrated success in leading enterprise data modernizations, analytics platform builds, or AI-ready data engineering initiatives preferred.**

ea76114a.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
ea76114a.description:
**Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, resilience, and day-to-day health of HealthEdge's infrastructure across AWS and our hybrid on-prem/Azure/GCP estate. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering and infrastructure engineering spanning AWS migration execution, disaster recovery, patching and platform currency, and the security/compliance controls that keep our security obligations intact. It's a hands-on senior IC role for someone who wants deep ownership of infrastructure resilience across a large, multi-account, multi-platform environment that's actively migrating off legacy on-prem infrastructure.

**Areas of Responsibility:**

**Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud Architecture**

* Own infrastructure across the environments including secure configuration baselines and patch management for OS images and on-prem hardware
* Design, build, and maintain infrastructure across AWS (primary), with supporting work in Azure and GCP, plus the on-prem estate still in active retirement
* Build and maintain reusable, auditable Infrastructure as Code for cloud deployments, and for remaining on-prem server deployment.
* Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work.
* Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts.
* Support AWS migration execution for in-flight waves, including server deployments and resource change requests via IaC.

**Disaster Recovery & Resilience**

* Own disaster recovery architecture and execution across cloud environments.
* Maintain DR solutions and backup strategy and run DR drills on a regular cadence; document gaps and drive remediation.
* Design for resilience from the start and treat recoverability as a first-class requirement, not an afterthought.

**Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management**

* Contribute to vulnerability management triage across infrastructure teams, threat detection, and infra security findings review.
* Support PHI/PII classification scanning, penetration test coordination, and security exception approvals.
* Maintain compliance controls; support HIPAA and SOC 2 audit readiness, access review and recertification, evidence collection, and change freeze coordination.
* Maintain EKS container runtime security sensor coverage as part of ongoing platform hardening.

**Cloud Infrastructure Operations**

* Design and manage roles and cross-account access controls following least-privilege principles across multi-account, multi-cloud environments.
* Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards.
* Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability.
* Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience.
* Own infrastructure health, cost, and performance monitoring using native and third-party tooling, building the observability that lets issues surface before they become incidents.
* Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services.
* Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate.

**CI/CD, Automation & Delivery**

* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines for secure, repeatable infrastructure deployments.
* Write automation to reduce manual toil and enforce operational consistency across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Take solutions from proof-of-concept to production with an eye toward long-term maintainability, not just getting it working once.

**Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor, scale, and maintain production infrastructure with availability, performance, and security as top priorities.
* Participate in on-call rotation; serve as L2 escalation point for cross-team infrastructure support; lead root cause analysis and drive incident retrospectives to closure.
* Author and maintain runbooks that hold up under pressure, not just at handoff.

**Cost & Tagging Governance**

* Contribute to FinOps efforts: identify and remediate cost anomalies, own tagging remediation against enterprise tagging standards, and make pragmatic cost/performance/resilience tradeoffs.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting.
* Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure.
* Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments.
* Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
* Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management.
* Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale.
* Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement.
* Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) and understanding of what that means for infrastructure and DR design specifically.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect or SysOps, Associate or Professional).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure, bridging on-prem virtualization with cloud-native services during active migration.
* Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows.
* FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement.
* Healthcare technology or digital health platform background.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows as part of daily practice.

**Behaviors & Traits**

* Raises risk early rather than waiting for it to become an incident.
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a large, multi-account, evolving cloud environment.
* Strong sense of ownership; closes gaps rather than escalating and waiting.
* Communicates technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.

This is a process-driven, customer-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL-aligned support environment.

You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).

**Key Responsibilities**

You will deliver day-to-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.

Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.

As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 & L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.

You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.

Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.

You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.

Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.

You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance

 **Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience working in an application support or service desk role (2 to 3 years preferred)
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift-based model and collaborate across global teams

**Desirable Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems

**Key Behaviours & Attributes**

* Customer-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

8de87ed8.title: Cloud Operations Lead
8de87ed8.description:
We are seeking a **Cloud Operations Lead/ DevOps Engineer Lead** to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will maintain, optimize, and scale our AWS cloud infrastructure while ensuring high availability and robust system performance. You will bridge the gap between core development and operational excellence by implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and participating in incident management cycles.

Unlike a traditional pure-play SRE role, this position focuses heavily on reliable cloud operations, infrastructure deployment, and proactive monitoring.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cloud Infrastructure Management:** Maintain and optimize **AWS core services**, focusing on high-availability configurations, **Load Balancers (ALB/NLB)**, and multi-region networking.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Write, maintain, and troubleshoot clean **Terraform** scripts to automate the provisioning of cloud environments.
* **Disaster Recovery (DR):** Design, test, and execute robust **DR strategies** and backup mechanisms to ensure business continuity.
* **Operational Monitoring & NOC:** Participate in Network Operations Center (NOC) activities, monitoring system health, and ensuring system alerts are actionable.
* **Incident Management:** Actively participate in incident response workflows, helping triage production issues, minimize downtime, and document post-incident reviews.
* **Technical Ownership:** Take ownership of operational tasks, driving them from identification to resolution with minimal supervision.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* **Minimum 6+ years** of professional experience in Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, with a demonstrated trajectory of technical ownership and leadership.
* Strong understanding of Linux, Windows, networking fundamentals, and cloud infrastructure concepts.
* Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring platforms, and incident management processes.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch
* **AWS Expertise:** Proven hands-on experience with core AWS services (EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM) and a solid understanding of cloud networking architecture.
* **Practical IaC Experience:** Strong foundational knowledge of **Terraform** (modules, state management, and workspaces) to manage infrastructure safely.

c76bbd81.description:
**Job Profile:**

We are seeking a passionate, technically competent, and highly driven Program Manager / Project Manager – Research & Development to lead, design, and manage our evolving sustainable technology and clean energy

portfolios. Bindi International operates on the fundamental belief that women must be at the forefront of economic and social development.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Technical Framework Design and Model Development**

● Develop comprehensive and adaptable operational blueprints, safety manuals, and playbooks for decentralized technology assembly and maintenance.

● Ensure all R&D innovations are scalable, reliable, and replicable across diverse last-mile rural contexts spanning multiple states.

● Align R&D project delivery pathways with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs).

**2. In-House Battery Pack Production & Quality Control ("Bindi Shakti Battery")**

● Lead and optimize technical operations for the in-house battery pack assembly unit, standardizing production for five core configurations.

● Supervise quality standards, safety thresholds, and technical compliance across multiple cell chemistries:

○ NMC Configurations – 3.7V–7.8Ah cells for micro-lighting systems; 36V (7.8Ah/10Ah) battery

packs for light electric vehicles.

○ LFP Configurations – 12.8V (30Ah & 42Ah) battery packs optimized for Solar Home Systems and emergency power storage.

● Implement strict hardware validation protocols, including Internal Resistance (IR) testing, spot-welding uniformity checks, high/low voltage cutoff verification, and thermal safety cycling.

● Establish frameworks to prototype, test, and manufacture custom battery packs based on client specifications for E-Bicycles, E-Bikes, E-Scooters, and E-Rickshaws.

**3. E-Mobility Platform Integration & Optimization ("Sakthi Cycle")**

● Coordinate end-to-end engineering, Bill of Materials (BOM), and assembly workflows for the Sakthi Cycle e-mobility platform.

● Ensure component compatibility and performance integration across 250W BLDC hub motors, 36V smart controllers, 6-magnet Pedal Assist Sensors (PAS), and dual disc braking systems.

● Validate performance and safety standards in compliance with regulatory norms, including a maximum speed limit of 25 km/h and a target operational range of 40–50 km.

● Adapt high-tensile carbon steel chassis designs for rugged rural usage, optimizing heavy-duty cargo carriers, integrated lighting systems, and horn systems.

**4. Training, Capacity Building, and Field Deployment**

● Translate complex engineering specifications, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic manuals into accessible, visual training modules.

● Conduct continuous capacity-building workshops for rural women engineers to enhance their confidence and competence in electrical troubleshooting, field repairs, and hardware safety.

● Support field teams during regional pilot deployments to ensure successful implementation and long-term sustainability.

**5. Monitoring, Evaluation, and Compliance**

● Establish robust testing frameworks and product lifecycle tracking systems to monitor battery degradation, field failure rates, and product performance over time.

● Ensure all manufactured systems comply with relevant industrial certifications and standards, including IS 16045 and BIS requirements.

● Analyze field performance data to continuously refine and improve hardware engineering designs.

**6. Stakeholder Management & Documentation**

● Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships among internal execution teams, external component suppliers, B2B enterprise clients, and institutional partners.

● Maintain accurate technical records, assembly documentation, progress trackers, and case studies demonstrating technological impact on rural livelihood generation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Candidates passionate about social enterprise and women-led development models.
* Comfortable working autonomously and building operational processes from the ground up without relying on predefined corporate structures.
* Willing to relocate to or stay in Harmada (Kishangarh, Rajasthan) for the duration of the role, with flexibility to travel intermittently to remote field clusters.
* Conversational proficiency in Hindi, in addition to strong English communication skills, for effective interaction with local assembly teams.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Hardware Prototyping and Battery Pack Manufacturing
* Lithium-based Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Charging Logic and Circuit Diagnostics
* Battery Safety Systems
* Renewable Energy Systems and Electric Vehicle Development
* Cross-functional Stakeholder and Vendor Management

**Experience:**

* 3–7 years of proven experience in hardware prototyping, battery pack manufacturing, renewable energy systems, and electric vehicle development.
* Strong understanding of lithium-based Battery Management Systems (BMS), charging logic, circuit diagnostics, and battery safety systems.

**Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Battery Technology, Renewable Energy Systems, Mechatronics, or a related technical field

**Location:**  
The position will be based at Bindi International, Tilonia-Harmada Road, Village Harmada, District Ajmer, Rajasthan – 305812, India

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview:**
The AI Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling the enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence by building, operating, and evolving shared AI platforms, services, governance capabilities, and operational practices. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant AI infrastructure that empowers teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives that support the evolution of Mastercard's AI platform ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, manage dependencies, reduce execution risk, and ensure successful delivery of strategic programs.
  
  
This team functions as an enterprise AI Platform Engineering organization, delivering and operating shared capabilities that enable application teams to build and scale AI-powered products across public and private cloud environments.
  
  
This role provides the opportunity to help shape and execute the roadmap for Mastercard's next generation AI platform capabilities. Rather than focusing on a single product or application, you will drive programs that span platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, governance, operational excellence, and enterprise adoption.
  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving large-scale technology delivery, platform adoption, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, operational readiness, governance, and organizational transformation while helping shape Mastercard's long-term AI platform strategy.
  
  
**About The Role:**
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for leading large-scale technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operationalization. You will coordinate work across multiple engineering and business organizations, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered successfully.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with sufficient technical depth to engage effectively with engineers, architects, and technology leaders. You are passionate about execution, organizational effectiveness, continuous improvement, and enabling teams to deliver complex technology solutions at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from initiation through deployment and operational readiness.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans that account for dependencies, risks, resource requirements, milestones, and evolving business priorities.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Establish clear program objectives, success metrics, execution strategies, and delivery mechanisms.
* Proactively identify, manage, and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational blockers.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program status, ensuring stakeholders have timely, accurate, and actionable information.
* Drive effective decision-making by facilitating discussions, evaluating tradeoffs, and escalating issues when necessary.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple teams, ensuring dependencies are understood, managed, and communicated effectively.
* Develop executive-ready communications, dashboards, status updates, presentations, and program reviews.
* Lead planning sessions, steering committees, roadmap reviews, operational reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
* Establish governance, reporting, and operational mechanisms that improve transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve delivery processes, operating models, planning practices, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure programs meet organizational standards for security, compliance, risk management, operational readiness, and business continuity.
* Utilize metrics and data-driven insights to assess program health, communicate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support strategic planning, portfolio management, roadmap development, prioritization, and organizational scaling initiatives.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and customer focus.

**All About You:**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.
* Experience communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing competing priorities and delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments.
* Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.
* Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation and reporting.
* Experience working within highly collaborative, cross-functional technology organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting cloud platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, infrastructure platforms, or enterprise software systems.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, system architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology delivery practices.
* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.
* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.
* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to work for one of our clients in the health and wellness sector.

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to work closely with the CTO and technology team and drive execution across multiple software, AI, mobile, web, ERP, and integration initiatives.

This is not a traditional project coordination role.

We are looking for someone who can combine technical understanding, structured thinking, execution ownership, strong communication, and deep use of AI tools to help teams move from ideas and requirements to well-planned, well-executed, and clearly communicated outcomes.

The TPM will work closely with engineering, QA, product, design, business teams, external partners, and leadership.

**Must have skill**

* Approximately 4 years of experience in technical project/program management, product delivery, business analysis, or software delivery.
* Strong experience working with software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of modern application architecture and software development workflows.
* Experience managing multiple technology initiatives in parallel.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum or similar delivery approaches.
* Strong requirement-gathering and documentation skills.
* Experience with BRDs, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted tools extensively in day-to-day work.
* Experience with project-management platforms such as Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Azure DevOps, or similar tools is expected.

**Good to have skill**

* SaaS or consumer technology products
* AI / LLM-based applications
* Mobile applications, Web applications, API-driven systems, Ecommerce, ERP systems
* CI/CD, QA and release management, Technical Business Analysis, Software development or QA background

**What You'll Own**

You will be responsible for driving technology initiatives from requirement discussion through planning, execution, release, and stakeholder communication.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Work closely with the CTO on technology priorities, projects, and delivery planning.
* Convert discussions and requirements into clear project plans, milestones, tasks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Coordinate developers, QA engineers, designers, product teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Own sprint planning, backlog management, task tracking, status visibility, and delivery follow-ups.
* Identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and missing decisions early.
* Ensure requirements are clear before they reach development.
* Help prepare and maintain BRDs, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
* Break complex requirements into structured and actionable workstreams.
* Coordinate QA, UAT, release planning, and production rollouts.
* Maintain clear project documentation, decision logs, and release notes.
* Drive follow-ups and ensure action items are closed.
* Maintain visibility across multiple parallel projects and priorities.
* Own and continuously improve the project-management tools and workflows used by the technology team.
* Prepare project and technology status updates for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Present completed work, releases, progress, risks, and upcoming plans clearly to business stakeholders.

**Technical Thinking**

This role requires more than tracking tasks.

You should be able to understand modern software systems well enough to participate meaningfully in technical discussions.

You should be comfortable thinking about areas such as:

* Authentication and authorization
* Roles and permissions
* APIs and integrations
* Frontend and backend systems
* Databases
* Mobile applications
* Webhooks
* Background jobs
* Cloud infrastructure
* Environments
* CI/CD
* Logging and monitoring
* Security
* Data flows
* Failure handling
* Third-party integrations

You are not expected to be the architect or write production code, but you should be able to ask the right questions, identify gaps, understand dependencies, and challenge unclear requirements.

**AI-Assisted Working**

AI-assisted working is an important part of our engineering culture.

Our team actively uses tools such as
**Claude Code and Kiro**
, and we expect the TPM to use AI deeply across day-to-day work.

AI may be used for:

* Requirement analysis
* BRD and PRD preparation
* Identifying missing requirements
* User-story creation
* Acceptance criteria
* Task decomposition
* Technical research
* Understanding APIs and documentation
* Understanding unfamiliar codebases
* Summarizing architecture and system flows
* Risk identification
* Sprint planning
* Meeting summaries
* Decision tracking
* Release notes
* Stakeholder updates
* Presentations
* Project documentation
* Root-cause-analysis support

The candidate should be comfortable using AI to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs and applying sound judgment.

Experience with Claude Code, Kiro, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools is an advantage.

**Project & Delivery Management**

You will own the operating rhythm of technology projects.

This includes:

* Project planning
* Sprint planning
* Backlog management
* Epics and user stories
* Prioritization

+ Establish program governance (cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management) for Sales & Marketing IT initiatives.

* Program Delivery & Execution

+ Create and own the program plan including cross-functional key deliverables. Negotiate and get cross functional alignment. Partner with Business and IT teams to align and commit on the program Scope, Schedule and Resources.
+ Own the full lifecycle: demand intake, scoping, solution approach, detailed planning, execution, testing / UAT, deployment, stabilization, and post-go-live optimization.
+ Build and manage integrated plans that cover business milestones, technical delivery, dependencies, data and reporting, and change management.
+ Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

* Sales & Marketing Domain Leadership

+ Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:

- CRM (i.e. CPQ Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing integrations)
- Marketing automation and web marketing (i.e. Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, campaign and lead lifecycle)

+ Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
+ Drive structured stakeholder engagement, including steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, and change-management updates.
+ Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal to manage vendor relationships, SaaS licensing, and contracts across Sales & Marketing tools.
+ Track budgets and spend across programs, provide regular financial updates, including forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
+ Ensure vendors and system integrators deliver to contracted scope, quality, and timelines.
+ Champion best practices in program management, GTM process design, and application lifecycle management for Sales & Marketing IT.
+ Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance user experience.
+ Mentor project managers, business analysts, and scrum masters, foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 8 years leading Sales & Marketing or GTM-focused programs.
* Understanding of Sales & Marketing processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and prompt engineering to synthesize complex program data, conduct rapid risk analysis, and produce executive-level reporting.
* Track record of integrating frontier AI tools into daily program management practices to enhance operational velocity, optimize stakeholder communication, and drive efficient problem-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior business leaders.
* Proven track record establishing program governance, managing budgets, and driving projects to successful completion in fast-paced environments.
* Proficiency with Agile and hybrid delivery models, and with project / program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases, quantify ROI, and make data-driven decisions.

**Nice To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus.
* Experience in high-growth technology companies working closely with global Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations teams.
* Formal program / project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent).

7914fb8a.title: Solutions Consultant / Senior Solutions Consultant
7914fb8a.description:
**About the Role:**

Solutions Consultants at Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.

**What You'll Do :**

● Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in-depth understanding of all our products is required.

● Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.

● Drive Revenue: Act as a critical enabler for our enterprise sales pipeline. You'll lead technical discussions, build compelling solution demonstrations, and author detailed RFP responses for major deals. Your expertise and communication will directly influence our revenue attainment goals.

● Be an Industry Expert: Drive the strategic viewpoint of the organization towards specific vertical solutions. You'll use your deep industry knowledge to be a change leader for innovative solutions that solve larger, systemic problems within a particular vertical.

● Connect the Dots: Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure a seamless end-to-end process—from solution design to successful deployment for key deals. You'll be the go-to resource for connecting our technology to real-world business value.

● Champion Knowledge: Contribute to our internal knowledge base and foster a culture of expertise. You'll serve as a subject matter expert, mentoring peers and authoring documentation to elevate the entire team.

**What We're Looking For :**

● Problem Solver: Proven creative problem-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.

● Payments Expert: At least 3 + years of experience in the payments or fintech space, with a background in a product, solutions, or sales-related role.

● Technical Practitioner: Hands-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.

● Enterprise Advisor: Demonstrated expertise in providing advisory and guidance on large enterprise deployments and complex applications, with a history of identifying additional business opportunities.

● Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. You have a proven ability to create and deliver technical and business-focused presentations and documents that influence others and achieve results.

● Documentation Finesse: Established ability in crafting compelling presentations & solution documents

● Education: MBA is preferred.

**Company Description**
StraightUp Capital Realty is a new-age real estate mandate and consulting firm that reshapes how property investments and developer sales are managed across India. The company partners with developers, investors, and homebuyers to deliver data-driven, transparent, and performance-based solutions that build trust and drive growth. With strong expertise in exclusive project mandates, channel partner ecosystems, investor relations, and market intelligence, StraightUp Capital Realty supports high-value residential and estate projects. Its tech-first approach, proven track record in lead conversion, and dedicated relationship management set it apart in the real estate market. The team is focused on clarity, speed, and accountability while scaling rapidly in India’s property sector.

This is a full-time, on-site Pre Sales role based in Bengaluru. The Pre Sales professional will support the sales and consulting teams by qualifying leads, preparing client presentations, and coordinating with developers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding client requirements, conducting preliminary market and project research, and presenting tailored solutions that align with investment and mandate objectives. The role will involve responding to inquiries, managing pre-sales documentation, assisting in proposal creation, and maintaining accurate records in CRM tools. The Pre Sales professional will also collaborate with marketing teams on lead-generation initiatives and provide feedback to improve sales pitches and client engagement.

94118896.title: Presales Executive
94118896.description:
Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) Remote (India)

  

• Full-time • 12 years' experience

  

JOB DESCRIPTION

  

PTC is hiring a Junior Presales Executive to review global and domestic EOIs, RFPs and RFQs and to draft complete, compliant tender responses with our technical teams. Role snapshot Job title Department Location Reports to Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) Presales & Solutions Remote (India); occasional travel for pre-bid meetings Presales Manager / Head of Solutions Works closely with Solution architects, delivery leads, sales, finance, legal Experience 12 years in presales, bid support, tender documentation or proposal writing Employment type Full-time, permanent About PTC and the role Pauls Techno Crafts (PTC) is a technology staffing and software consulting company headquartered in Hyderabad, with a presence in Allen, Texas. We deliver IT staffing, software consulting, enterprise applications, managed network and security services, and digital transformation to clients in India and abroad. This role is the first filter and the main pen in our bid process. You will read every incoming opportunity, tell us quickly whether it fits, and then turn our technical team's input into a clear, compliant and on-time submission. You will learn bid strategy from senior presales and architecture staff as you go. Key responsibilities Opportunity tracking and review • Monitor domestic and global tender sources daily: GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), state e-procurement portals, PSU and bank portals, and international sources such as UNGM, World Bank, ADB and private-sector RFP invitations. • Read EOIs, RFPs and RFQs end to end and prepare a 1–2 page bid summary: scope, eligibility, pre-qualification criteria, evaluation method (QCBS, L1, technical scoring), deadlines, EMD/bid security and key commercial terms. • Flag go/no-go risks early: turnover and experience thresholds, certifications (ISO, CMMI), OEM authorisations, local-presence clauses, penalties, liability caps and payment terms. • Maintain a bid calendar covering pre-bid meetings, query deadlines, corrigenda and submission dates. Tender drafting with the technical team • Build a compliance matrix that maps every requirement clause to a response, owner and supporting document. • Brief solution architects and delivery leads on what each section needs; collect their inputs and turn them into clear, consistent proposal text. PTC | Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) | Remote Page 1Pauls Techno Crafts Encompassing Technical Craftsmanship JOB DESCRIPTION • Draft standard sections, with review by senior presales staff: cover letters, company profile, understanding of scope, approach and methodology, project plan, team structure, staffing model, SLAs and assumptions. • Draft pre-bid queries and clarification requests, and track responses and corrigenda. • Coordinate with finance and legal on commercial bids, BOQ/price schedules, EMD, bank guarantees and declarations. Submission and compliance • Assemble the final bid package to the buyer's format: technical and commercial envelopes, annexures, formats, affidavits, power of attorney and signed forms. • Run final checks for completeness, page limits, formatting, version control and PTC brand standards. • Manage online submissions on e-procurement portals, including digital signature certificate (DSC) uploads and encryption steps. Knowledge base and reporting • Maintain a reusable content library: case studies, CVs, certificates, financial statements, client references and boilerplate answers. • Record win/loss outcomes, competitor pricing where published, and lessons learned after each bid. • Share a weekly pipeline update of opportunities reviewed, in progress, submitted and awarded. Required qualifications and skills • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or Business Administration; an MBA is a plus. • 1–2 years in presales, bid management, tender support or proposal writing, ideally in IT services, consulting or system integration. • Basic understanding of the tender lifecycle: EOI, RFI, RFP, RFQ, pre-bid, corrigendum, technical and commercial evaluation, award. • Exposure to at least one e-procurement portal such as GeM or CPPP; we will train you on the rest. • Strong written English: able to turn technical notes into clear, structured and persuasive text. • Careful attention to detail; able to spot missing documents, eligibility gaps and conflicting clauses. • Good command of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint, including styles, tables of contents, tracked changes and basic formulas. • Able to handle several bids with fixed deadlines and to follow up firmly with internal teams over video calls, chat and shared documents. • Basic understanding of IT services: software development, staffing models, cloud, data, security and managed services. Good to have • Exposure to international RFPs (Middle East, US, Europe or multilateral agencies) and their formats. •

Familiarity with GFR 2017, the Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services, and Make in India / MSE purchase preferences. • Exposure to QCBS and LCS evaluation models and to preparing technical scoring self-assessments. • Basic knowledge of commercial terms: EMD, performance bank guarantee, liquidated damages and payment milestones. • Proposal or bid management training, such as APMP Foundation. • Experience with proposal tools or a shared content library (SharePoint, Confluence or Google Drive). PTC | Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) | Remote Page 2Pauls Techno Crafts Encompassing Technical Craftsmanship How success is measured Measure JOB DESCRIPTION Target Bid summary turnaround after a new EOI/RFP/RFQ is published Within 2 working days Bids submitted on time 100% Bids rejected for missing documents or non-compliance Compliance matrix prepared for every bid pursued Content library Independent drafting Zero 100% Set up in 3 months; kept current after each bid Owns standard sections of a full bid within 6 months What we offer • Direct exposure to domestic and international bids across staffing, consulting and managed services. • Mentoring from senior presales staff and PTC's Architecture Centre of Excellence. • A clear growth path to Presales Executive and Bid Manager. •

  

Fully remote work and a competitive salary, based on experience. You will need a reliable laptop and internet connection.

88205a39.title: Consultant  FinTech Product & Solutions
88205a39.description:
**Job Description**

  

We are seeking a sharp, high-potential FinTech Consultant with strong financial-services domain expertise, business acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and a genuine curiosity to understand complex business challenges. The ideal candidate should be able to engage confidently with clients and senior stakeholders, understand business goals and customer needs, challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and translate complex financial workflows into clear product requirements and practical solutions. You should be comfortable working across business, product, design, and engineering teams, taking ownership from discovery through delivery, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, products, and business outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead client discovery conversations to understand business goals, customer needs, operational workflows, and existing systems.
* Translate business requirements into clear customer journeys, workflows, business rules, MVP scope, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, challenge assumptions, validate requirements, and recommend practical solutions.
* Bring strong financial-services domain knowledge to identify exceptions, dependencies, risks, and operational requirements.
* Work closely with designers, engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and solution options.
* Take ownership of requirements from discovery through implementation, UAT, and launch.
* Support teams in resolving requirement ambiguities, managing scope changes, and ensuring alignment with agreed business outcomes.
* Contribute to presales activities including opportunity discovery, proposals, solution scope, and client presentations.
* Identify opportunities to improve products, processes, and workflows rather than simply executing existing requirements.
* Create reusable fintech knowledge such as discovery checklists, process maps, reference workflows, and practical guidance for internal teams.

  

**Required Skills:**

  

* 5+ years of relevant experience in FinTech consulting, business analysis, product ownership, or closely related roles.
* Strong experience in at least one financial-services domain such as payments, digital banking, lending, mortgages, wealth and investments, core banking, or insurance.
* Hands-on experience taking a financial product or significant capability from discovery through production.
* Strong understanding of financial workflows, customer journeys, business processes, and operational requirements.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear workflows, prioritised requirements, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria.
* Experience leading client workshops and collaborating with business, product, operations, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Working understanding of APIs, third-party integrations, system interactions, and data flows.
* Ability to identify relevant regulatory, compliance, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, or equivalent.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience working across multiple client consulting or delivery engagements.
* Experience in presales discovery, proposal development, solution presentations, or client-facing consulting.
* Experience modernising financial products or integrating modern platforms with legacy systems.
* Experience evaluating AI or automation opportunities based on business value, human oversight, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience across multiple areas of the fintech ecosystem.
* Ability to create reusable frameworks, workflows, checklists, and domain knowledge resources.
* Ability to explain the reasoning behind recommendations and product decisions.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex client and product challenges.

  

**Soft Skills:**

  

* High-agency and proactive attitude.
* Strong learning ability and curiosity.
* Independent thinker who can challenge assumptions constructively.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Resourceful and adaptable approach to different business challenges.
* Ownership-driven mindset with focus on quality and business outcomes.

**AI Solutions Engineer**  
We're looking for an experienced **AI Solutions Engineer** to join our team. You'll be instrumental in developing a system that uses advanced AI models to predict issues, diagnose problems, and even automate resolutions, significantly enhancing our network's reliability and performance  
  
**About the Role**  
As an AI Solutions Engineer, you'll be a core member of our engineering team, responsible for the end-to-end development and operationalization of our AI Network Management Tool. This involves designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, integrating with various network systems and cloud services, and deploying sophisticated AI models. You'll work with large datasets, modern cloud technologies, and contribute directly to a platform that leverages Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide intelligent insights and automation for network incidents.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* **Design & Develop Scalable AI Solutions:** Build and optimize the core architecture and components of the AI Network Management Tool on Microsoft Azure, focusing on data ingestion, processing, indexing, and AI model integration.
* **Data Pipeline Engineering:** Create robust and efficient data pipelines to collect, transform, and store network data and incident information from diverse sources.
* **Database Management:** Design, implement, and manage highly available and performant database solutions (both relational and NoSQL) for storing processed data and analytics.
* **Azure Cloud Infrastructure:** Provision, configure, and manage Azure cloud resources (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Blob Storage, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service) using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles.
* **DevOps & MLOps:** Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and monitoring of AI models and application components within an Azure DevOps environment.
* **AI Model Integration:** Integrate and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) from Azure OpenAI Service, including embedding models for vectorization and advanced LLMs (like GPT-4/GPT-4o) for incident analysis, natural language understanding, and response generation within a RAG framework.
* **Problem Solving & Optimization:** Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and continuously optimize the platform for efficiency, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.

**What You'll Bring**

* **5+ years of experience** in software engineering or platform engineering, with a strong focus on building and deploying scalable solutions.
* **Expert-level proficiency in Python** for data manipulation, automation, and API integration.
* **Strong experience with database technologies**, including both relational databases (e.g., Azure SQL Database) and NoSQL databases (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB).
* **Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud services**, including but not limited to Azure Functions, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Storage (Blob/Data Lake), Azure AI Search, and Azure OpenAI Service.
* **Solid understanding and practical experience with DevOps principles and tools**, particularly Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos) and Git for version control.
* Proven ability to work with large, complex datasets and unstructured text.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

**Bonus Points**

* **Networking knowledge will be an added advantage.** Experience with network protocols, device configurations (e.g., Cisco, Aruba), network monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk), or network automation concepts.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio or other chatbot development platforms.
* Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI.

d5c27d60.title: Agentic AI Solution Architect
d5c27d60.description:
Role Purpose

TGC is transitioning its software engineering environment toward an Agentic-AI-first development model, where AI agents participate across requirements, architecture, frontend and backend development, testing, security, deployment and ongoing application maintenance.

We are looking for a hands-on Agentic AI Solution Architect who can architect, implement and govern this engineering environment.

This is not a conventional Solution Architect or Generative AI role. The successful candidate must be capable of using AI coding agents to build and deploy real production applications while establishing the architecture, guardrails and development practices required for engineering teams to work effectively with agents.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Architecture

- Design TGC's end-to-end Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (A-SDLC).

- Build and configure specialized agents for frontend, backend, database, QA, security and DevOps activities.

- Design effective system prompts, context engineering, tool access, agent memory and orchestration.

- Establish agent-to-agent workflows and human approval gates.

- Create reusable engineering instructions and standards across TGC products.

Application Architecture

Own and guide architecture across:

- Angular and TypeScript

- Angular Micro-Frontend architecture

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs

- Microservices

- SQL and NoSQL databases

- Azure cloud services

- API integrations

- Authentication, authorization and RBAC

- Scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Agentic Development

The role must be highly hands-on.

The candidate should be able to take:

Requirement → Architecture → Agent Instructions → Generated Code → Testing → Security Validation → Deployment without defaulting to manual coding whenever an agent encounters a problem.

When agents fail, the individual should diagnose whether the failure resulted from context, instructions, architecture, tooling, permissions, test coverage or model limitations and improve the agentic system accordingly.

DevOps & Deployment

- Design AI-assisted CI/CD workflows.

- Implement automated build, testing and deployment.

- Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub pipelines.

- Implement Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.

- Manage Azure Key Vault and application secrets securely.

- Establish automated rollback, logging and monitoring.

Engineering Governance

Create and enforce:

- Agent-first development standards

- Coding and architecture standards

- Automated testing requirements

- AI-generated code review processes

- Security validation

- Human approval gates

- Production deployment controls

- Documentation and traceability of agent-generated changes

Team Enablement

A major responsibility will be helping TGC's existing engineering team transition from conventional development to AI-native engineering.

Essential Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with:

- Agentic AI / AI coding agents

- LLM system prompting and context engineering

- Tool/function calling and agent orchestration

- MCP or equivalent agent-tool integration

- Git/GitHub

- Angular / TypeScript

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs and microservices

- SQL / database architecture

- Microsoft Azure

- Docker / containers

- CI/CD

- Automated testing

- Application security

Experience with modern AI development environments such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalent agentic coding platforms is highly desirable.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who thinks:

"How do I make the agent solve this reliably and repeatedly?"

rather than:

"I'll just fix the code myself."

The ideal candidate is:

- Architecturally strong

- Extremely hands-on

- Comfortable experimenting with rapidly evolving AI technology

- Strong at debugging AI-agent behaviour

- Able to distinguish AI limitations from poor instructions or architecture

- Security conscious

- Product and UX aware

- Comfortable challenging traditional software-development practices

- Capable of teaching other engineers how to work effectively with AI agents

Selection Process

Candidates should expect a practical assessment.

They may be provided with a partially functioning application and access to an AI coding environment and asked to:

Diagnose, correct, test and deploy the application primarily through AI agents rather than manually rewriting the code.

We are interested not simply in whether the candidate solves the problem, but how they design, instruct, supervise and improve the agentic engineering process used to solve it.

Success in the First 90 Days

The successful candidate should:

- Establish TGC's Agentic Development Architecture.

- Implement the Agentic SDLC.

- Create reusable FE, BE, QA, Security and DevOps agents.

- Establish automated development and deployment pipelines.

- Introduce measurable agentic engineering standards.

- Reduce dependence on manual coding.

- Improve development velocity without compromising security or quality.

- Transition the engineering team toward an AI-native development model.

Core Mandate

Build the engineering system that enables AI agents and humans together to deliver secure, scalable production software faster and more reliably.

Work Location Requirement: This is a full-time, work-from-office position based in Pune. Candidates must be willing to work from the Pune office; hybrid and remote working are not applicable to this role

Pay: ₹682,000.00 - ₹770,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Software Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of a multi-tenant AI platform, including the integration bus, semantic layer, agent runtime, workflow engine, and data stores. The role requires expertise in distributed systems, enterprise integrations, AI agents, scalability, and security.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target architecture and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* Finalize the durable workflow engine, tenancy model, and data-store boundaries within the first two weeks.
* Design and build the semantic resolution engine with AI engineers, translating plain-language definitions into systems, tools, and access rights.
* Define API contracts, event schemas, adapter contracts, supervisor graph state schemas, and security standards.
* Conduct design reviews, unblock engineers, and review critical code.
* Own scalability, tenant isolation, latency, data retention, disaster recovery, and load testing.
* Ensure the platform supports up to 10,000 concurrent runs.
* Collaborate with pilot customers' architects and security teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience designing and shipping scalable, multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, durable workflows, sagas, Kafka, idempotency, back-pressure, and failure handling.
* Expertise in relational, in-memory, and vector databases.
* Production experience with LLM-based systems, tool calling, agent orchestration, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, RAG, and evaluation.
* Enterprise integration experience with CRM, ERP, and legacy systems using REST, SOAP, JDBC, and file-based integrations.
* Strong understanding of B2B security architecture, RBAC, tenant isolation, secrets management, and PII handling.
* Hands-on coding experience and the ability to make and explain critical architecture decisions.

**Good to Have**

* Production experience with Temporal.
* Experience with Apache Camel or similar integration frameworks.
* Kubernetes operations at scale.
* Published technical talks, research papers, or open-source contributions.

**Key Focus Areas**

* Multi-tenancy and enterprise security
* Distributed systems and durable workflow execution
* AI agents, semantic resolution, and RAG
* Enterprise integrations and data architecture
* Scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery

What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
  
  
Cognite operates at the forefront of
**industrial digitalization, building AI**
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
  
  
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
  
  
**How You’ll Demonstrate Ownership**
As a Senior Solution Architect at Cognite, you will play a pivotal role in the Technology department within our Value Delivery organisation. In this customer-facing position, you will work directly with key customers, field sales, delivery teams, and product development. You will use your seniority and technical competencies to help to lead Norwegian and international industrial customers to increase productivity, profitability, reduce environmental impact and reduce costs. Our customers are large international process and energy industries, with challenges in asset performance and maintenance, production efficiency, and sustainability. Together with the team, you will define solutions and support each integration through to a successful finish.
  
  

* End-to-end architecture and solution design leadership.
* Providing strategic and technical expertise to support customers and the customer-facing project teams.
* Defining enterprise and solution architecture, including integration and data models and data ingestion pipelines, as well as user-facing solutions
* Expressing complex technical solutions through architecture modeling tools
* Ensure operational responsibility and support agreements for the delivered solutions
