47fd6eec.title: Technical Solution Architect - ThingWorx / SCPA
47fd6eec.description:
**Req ID:**
388377
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Technical Solution Architect - ThingWorx / SCPA to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description – Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA**
**Job Title:**
Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA
  
  
**Platform:**
ThingWorx 10.x
  
  
**Product Focus:**
Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) / SmartConnect
  
  
**Engagement Type:**
Solution Architecture, Design & Delivery
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ Years overall, including 5+ years of ThingWorx experience
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA**
to lead the architecture and solution design of the next-generation
**SmartConnect connected-product platform**
using
**ThingWorx 10.x and Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA)**
.
  
  
The architect will translate approved business requirements, user needs, and acceptance criteria into a
**secure, scalable, resilient, supportable, and maintainable technical solution**
. The role will provide technical direction across remote service access, endpoint automation, identity and access governance, enterprise integrations, master-data synchronization, and multiple user populations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in
**ThingWorx architecture and development**
, combined with strong knowledge of
**SCPA building blocks, IoT solution architecture, security, identity management, enterprise integration, and remote-access solutions**
.
  
  
A key objective of this role is to maximize the use of
**standard SCPA configuration and reusable building blocks**
, minimize unnecessary customization, and establish governed, upgrade-safe extension patterns where custom development is required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for SmartConnect using ThingWorx 10.x and SCPA.
* Define application, data, integration, security, deployment, infrastructure, and operational architecture.
* Translate business requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into traceable technical requirements, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Evaluate requirements against SCPA capabilities and determine the appropriate configure, integrate, extend, or custom-build approach.
* Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, solution documentation, technical standards, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Establish implementation guardrails and reusable architectural patterns for development teams.

ThingWorx & SCPA Architecture
  
  

* Design the overall ThingWorx Thing model and asset hierarchy.
* Define and govern:

+ Thing Templates
+ Thing Shapes
+ Data Shapes
+ Services
+ Events
+ Subscriptions
+ Persistence strategies
+ Mashups and application components

* Assess and leverage SCPA standard capabilities, reusable building blocks, extension points, and custom components.
* Ensure custom extensions are maintainable, testable, reusable, and designed to minimize future upgrade impact.

Remote Access & Endpoint Management
  
  

* Architect secure attended and unattended remote-access solutions for gateways and downstream endpoints.
* Define architecture for session routing, customer/user consent, endpoint availability, failure handling, auditability, clipboard access, and file transfer.
* Design secure gateway-to-endpoint communication and access patterns.
* Ensure remote-access capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity and least-privilege requirements.

Automation & Remote Package Execution
  
  

* Design automated file-watch ingestion and processing capabilities.
* Define targeted remote-package execution architecture, including:

+ Endpoint targeting
+ Integrity/checksum validation
+ Retry and failure-management policies
+ Execution status
+ Per-endpoint results
+ Audit records
+ Monitoring and observability

* Establish scalable automation patterns for managing distributed endpoints and connected assets.

Security, Identity & Access Governance
  
  

* Define Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege security architecture.
* Design static and dynamic visibility groups and segmented access models.
* Architect Just-In-Time (JIT) privileged-access approval workflows, including customer-owned approval processes.
* Define identity and authorization models supporting:

+ Customers
+ Internal employees
+ External contractors
+ Business partners

* Design identity federation and authentication patterns using enterprise identity platforms.
* Ensure security controls, authorization decisions, privileged access, and user activity are appropriately auditable.

Enterprise Integration & Master Data
  
  

* Define integration architecture between ThingWorx/SmartConnect and Unity (Salesforce) for endpoint master data.
* Establish system-of-record ownership and read-only data-field principles.
* Design synchronization, reconciliation, error handling, retry, and recovery mechanisms.
* Provide visibility into synchronization status and last-successful-sync information.
* Establish standards for REST APIs, events, data contracts, and integration patterns across enterprise systems.
* Support integrations with IAM/IdP platforms, Salesforce, CMDB, SAP, logging, monitoring, and other enterprise applications.

Non-Functional Architecture
  
  
Define and govern non-functional requirements covering:
  
  

* Availability and high availability
* Performance
* Scalability
* Resiliency and recovery
* Security and privacy
* Observability and monitoring
* Auditability
* Maintainability
* Supportability
* Deployment and release management

Ensure architectural decisions support production operations, troubleshooting, future enhancements, and platform upgrades.
  
  
Architecture Governance & Delivery Support
  
  

* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, threat-modeling discussions, and design-assurance activities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
* Review implementation designs and code to ensure compliance with approved architectural patterns.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to ThingWorx consultants, developers, integration engineers, and infrastructure teams.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, QA, Service Operations, Infrastructure, and enterprise integration teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.

Migration & Coexistence
  
  

* Define the migration strategy from the existing SmartConnect implementation to the next-generation platform.
* Develop migration and coexistence architecture to minimize business and operational disruption.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt during modernization.
* Define deployment, transition, rollback, and release strategies.

SmartConnect Capability Alignment
  
  
Capability AreaUser NeedsArchitect Responsibility
**Remote Access**
UN-1 to UN-4Define secure session management, gateway routing, consent, endpoint availability, transfer, failure handling, and audit architecture.
**Automation & Systematic Data**
UN-5 to UN-6Define ingestion, checksum validation, retry, endpoint targeting, execution, results, and observability patterns.
**Access Governance**
UN-7 to UN-9Architect visibility groups, RBAC, least privilege, and customer-owned JIT approval workflows.
**Unity Master-Data Synchronization**
UN-10Define system-of-record integration, reconciliation, ownership, synchronization, and failure-handling architecture.
**Multiple User Populations**
UN-11Define identity federation, population classification, policy enforcement, authorization, and auditable access patterns.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience designing enterprise software, industrial IoT, connected-product, remote-service, or similar technology solutions.
* 5+ years of hands-on ThingWorx architecture or senior development experience, including ThingWorx 9.x and/or 10.x.
* 3 to 5 years of strong experience with ThingWorx Composer, modeling, Mashups, services, events, subscriptions, security, persistence, deployment, and integrations.
* 3+ years of demonstrated experience with Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) or comparable ThingWorx solution/building-block architecture.
* 3 to 5 years of strong understanding of ThingWorx Thing Templates, Thing Shapes, Data Shapes, asset hierarchies, services, and persistence models.
* Experience designing secure remote-access, endpoint-management, connected-device, or fleet-automation solutions.
* Strong knowledge of RBAC, identity federation, segmented/multi-tenant visibility, approval workflows, audit logging, and least-privilege security principles.
* Experience designing enterprise REST/API and event-driven integrations.
* Experience integrating platforms such as Salesforce, IAM/IdP, CMDB, SAP, monitoring, and logging systems.
* Ability to translate functional requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into technical architecture and implementation guidance.
* Strong experience with architecture governance, design reviews, technical risk management, and documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical, security, operational, business, and executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ThingWorx Developer, Model Specialist, Deploy Specialist, or equivalent certification.
* Hands-on experience with SCPA extension points, custom building blocks, reusable components, and upgrade-safe architecture.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of SAML, OAuth/OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, identity federation, and privileged-access management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and ThingWorx persistence architecture.
* Experience designing high-availability ThingWorx environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and automated deployment.
* Experience working within regulated healthcare, medical-device, life-sciences, cybersecurity, or quality-controlled product environments.

Expected Deliverables
  
  
The Technical Solution Architect will be responsible for producing and maintaining:
  
  

* Solution Architecture Document
* Context, container, component, and integration diagrams
* SCPA fit-gap assessment
* Configure / Integrate / Extend / Custom-build recommendations
* ThingWorx Thing and asset model
* Data and persistence architecture
* Security and RBAC model
* Identity and federation architecture
* Visibility-group design
* Remote-access architecture
* JIT privileged-access workflow design
* Endpoint automation architecture
* Unity/Salesforce integration design
* API, event, and data contracts
* Non-functional requirements
* Operational and observability architecture
* Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
* Threat-model inputs
* Technical risk and mitigation plans
* Migration and coexistence architecture
* Deployment and release architecture
* Technical standards and implementation guardrails
* Architecture and design-review outcomes

Measures of Success
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:
  
  

* Deliver an architecture that provides clear traceability to approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maximize the use of SCPA standard configuration and reusable building blocks wherever practical.
* Minimize unnecessary customization and technical debt.
* Ensure custom development is justified, governed, testable, maintainable, reusable, and upgrade-safe.
* Build security, auditability, least privilege, resiliency, scalability, and operational supportability into the architecture from the outset.
* Provide development and delivery teams with clear architectural decisions, interfaces, standards, and non-functional expectations.
* Enable successful migration to the next-generation SmartConnect platform with minimal disruption to existing users and operations.

Key Skills
  
  
**ThingWorx 10.x | Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) | ThingWorx Architecture | Industrial IoT | Connected Products | Thing Modeling | Thing Templates | Thing Shapes | Data Shapes | Mashups | REST APIs | Remote Access | Endpoint Management | RBAC | JIT Access | Identity Federation | SAML | OIDC | Microsoft Entra ID | Salesforce Integration | PostgreSQL | Azure | Security Architecture | API & Integration Architecture | High Availability | Observability | CI/CD | Solution Architecture**
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. This role provides technical guidance on custom application and data solution implementations within the business technology team. The Application Architect collaborates with Project teams, Enterprise Architecture, Product Managers, and Business Stakeholders to determine solutions based on business requirements and consults on their implementation.

  

**Role & responsibilities** :

* Evaluate and analyze business needs and current technical assets/data to develop and implement solutions and strategy for applications.
* Perform application technology planning and drive technical product roadmaps with the product manager, suggesting improvements to increase efficiency, scalability, and maximize product value.
* Interact and communicate effectively with business sponsors, technology management, executives, end users, and subject matter experts.

* Create and maintain technical application architecture depicting the Business and IT landscape in its current, transitional, and future state for a portfolio of applications.
* Utilize enterprise application policies and standards for design, integration, scalability, navigation, maintainability, and reuse of capabilities in designs of solutions.
* Provide technical consultation for technology and software solutions based on business needs; oversee architectural aspects of business solution development and deployment.

8+ years of experience in application technologyprimarily within application architecture and development, including experience with TOGAF and Zachman frameworks, SOA, integration patterns, solution design, target architecture, cloud platforms, technology maturity models, Java, .NET, Python, microservices, and governance.

* Extensive experience working with application teams, vendors, or service providers; considerable experience with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) methodologies and design/architecture aspects of project delivery.

**Job Description: Cloud Data architect**

enGen Global is an emerging global healthcare partner that delivers strategic innovation, expertise, and flexibility to its healthcare partners. Thryve delivers next-generation solutions that enable our healthcare partners to provide positive experiences to their consumers.

Our global collaborative of healthcare, operations, and IT experts creates innovative and sustainable processes for our clients, which keeps the ever-evolving consumers engaged and assists them in managing the future of their healthcare better. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Thryve is an equal opportunity employer and places a high value on integrity, diversity, and inclusion in the organization. We do not discriminate based on any protected attribute. For more information about the organization, please visit www.thryvedigital.com

**Role Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Lead Data Architect to design, build, and optimize our next-generation enterprise data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This pivotal role will be responsible for defining the architectural roadmap, leading the technical design, and ensuring the successful implementation of robust, scalable, and secure data solutions that support our strategic business objectives. * Utilize data transformation tools like dbt (data build tool) for efficient and version-controlled data modeling and transformation within BigQuery.
* Implement and manage data storage solutions leveraging Apache Iceberg for open table formats, enabling schema evolution and time travel capabilities.
* Design and enforce data quality frameworks, processes, and tools to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the enterprise.
* Collaborate with data governance teams to define policies and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
* Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for data pipelines and platform health
* Integrate and configure Starburst (Trino) for federated query capabilities across diverse data sources and BigLake Metastore for unified metadata management
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to data engineers and other technical teams.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, US team and application development teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends in data architecture, GCP services, and open-source data platforms
* Provide regular updates on the tasks, status and risks to project manager

**Required Experience**

* Bachelors degree or higher from a reputed university
* 12 to 18 years of progressive experience in data architecture, data engineering or similar role
* 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing large-scale data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Demonstrated expertise with BigQuery, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, and other relevant GCP data services.
* Strong proficiency in PySpark for data processing and transformation – for both and streaming patterns
* Experience in streaming tools like Kafka, Pub-Sub, spark streaming etc.
* Extensive experience with modern data warehousing principles, data lakes, and Data lakehouse architectures.
* Hands-on experience with open table formats, specifically Apache Iceberg.
* Experience implementing data governance frameworks, data quality tools, and metadata management solutions.
* Strong understanding of security best practices in a cloud data environment.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines for data solutions is a plus
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

**Good to have**

* Experience with federated query engines like Starburst (Trino) and unified metadata solutions like BigLake Metastore is highly desirable.
* Proven experience with data transformation tools such as dbt (data build tool).
* Experience in processing streaming data using Kafka / Pub-Sub
* Healthcare industry experience
* Experience in Agile

9131cd8a.description:
ServiceNow Functional Architect is responsible for defining the functional architecture, process design, capability roadmap, and value realization of the ServiceNow platform across a complex global enterprise. The role translates business and technology priorities into scalable, standardized, and supportable ServiceNow solutions spanning IT Service Management, Security Operations, Asset Management, and Strategic Portfolio Management.

The architect serves as a strategic partner to global business leaders, IT operations, cybersecurity, asset management, portfolio management, enterprise architecture, data teams, and implementation partners. The role leads requirements discovery, operating model design, cross-module integration, process harmonization, solution governance, and adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data, and regulatory requirements.

Automation and artificial intelligence are critical elements of this position. The successful candidate will identify, prioritize, and architect high-value opportunities using workflow automation, orchestration, virtual agents, predictive intelligence, generative AI, AI agents, and decision support. The role will establish guardrails for responsible AI, measurable value, human oversight, data quality, and sustainable operational ownership.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the functional architecture, capability roadmap, and governance framework for the ServiceNow platform.
* Lead requirements gathering, process design, capability mapping, fit-gap assessments, and solution architecture activities across ServiceNow modules.
* Architect and optimize solutions across IT Service Management (ITSM), Security Operations, Asset Management (HAM/SAM), and Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
* Design scalable enterprise workflows, service models, and operating processes that align with business objectives and platform best practices.
* Identify and deliver automation, orchestration, and AI-enabled solutions using Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, Generative AI, and intelligent workflows.
* Establish architecture standards, process frameworks, governance controls, and design patterns to ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Partner with technical architects, developers, and integration teams to deliver solutions aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Provide architecture oversight for platform upgrades, enhancements, integrations, digital transformation initiatives, and complex enterprise programs.
* Design and govern CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), service mapping, and data management practices across the platform.
* Collaborate with Cybersecurity teams to support Vulnerability Management, platform security, API governance, and risk-management initiatives.
* Lead ServiceNow Asset Management strategies, including Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management Professional (SAMP) capabilities.
* Support Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) processes, including demand management, project governance, application portfolio management, and Agile delivery.
* Facilitate architecture reviews, stakeholder workshops, and governance forums to drive platform standardization and business alignment.
* Develop platform adoption metrics, executive dashboards, and value-realization reporting to measure business outcomes and continuous improvement.
* Mentor business analysts, product owners, administrators, and delivery teams on ServiceNow best practices, automation, AI adoption, and platform governance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology, platform consulting, service management, business process design, or functional architecture.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow functional architecture or solution design experience in large enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across ITSM and at least two of the following areas: Security Operations, IT Asset Management, or Strategic Portfolio Management.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM capabilities including Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge, Service Catalog, CMDB, and Service Operations Workspace.
* Experience designing enterprise workflows, governance processes, operating models, integrations, and service management solutions.
* Strong understanding of workflow automation, AI-enabled service management, Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, and Generative AI capabilities.
* Experience with CMDB, Common Service Data Model (CSDM), Service Mapping, and enterprise data governance practices.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL, Agile delivery methodologies, enterprise architecture principles, and platform governance.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, ITAM, SPM, Vulnerability Response, or related modules.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Certified Master Architect (CMA).
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience with Hardware Asset Management (HAM), Software Asset Management Professional (SAMP), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Security Operations, and Vulnerability Management.
* Experience implementing enterprise automation strategies, AI governance frameworks, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation, platform modernization, mergers and acquisitions, or global ServiceNow deployments.
* Experience working within global engineering, technology, consulting, professional services, or multi-vendor environments.

Insurance Product Implementation • Application Delivery Management • Stakeholder & Client Management • SLA/OLA Management • Delivery Governance • Team Leadership • Capacity Planning • Risk & Escalation Management • Process Improvement • AI-Assisted Delivery Practices

Would you like to help shape a secure, resilient, and scalable operating model for a mission-critical Azure managed environment?

The Azure Managed Environment team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead secure, resilient, and scalable platform operations. The successful candidate will drive tenant and subscription administration, platform configuration, governance, security controls, cost optimization, patching, and user support while strengthening internal expertise, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

In this role, the candidate will partner across engineering, security, governance, operations, and business teams to improve service reliability, accelerate decision-making, and establish repeatable processes and controls. The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management with Azure platform knowledge, operational discipline, and an automation-first mindset.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Establish operational governance: Define clear ownership, service processes, controls, decision forums, metrics, and reporting that improve accountability and execution.

* Support control implementation: Coordinate intake, impact assessment, architecture alignment, implementation planning, and operational readiness for new security and platform controls.
* Communicate with leaders: Provide clear, decision-ready updates on service health, risk posture, delivery status, dependencies, and investment priorities.

* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
* Bachelor's Degree AND 4+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with Azure security controls, cloud governance, cost management, patching, identity, or privileged-access risk.
* Experience partnering with internal engineering and operations teams to manage critical processes and oversee the delivery of managed services.
* Experience applying automation, telemetry, dashboards, or AI-enabled workflows to improve operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

d8be8fba.title: Regional Data Center Program Manager
d8be8fba.description:
**Overview**

As a **Regional Data Center Program Manager**, you will drive the successful mobilisation, onboarding and operational readiness of new data centre capacity across the APAC region. You will work across local Data Center Operations teams, engineering, deployment, construction, networking, vendors and regional/global stakeholders to deliver complex programmes safely, predictably and at scale.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Regional Datacenter Program Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

Key responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end mobilisation and onboarding programmes for new data centres and major infrastructure deployments, establishing clear plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners and readiness criteria.

Drive programme execution from early mobilisation through operational readiness and transition, ensuring critical dependencies and deliverables are identified, tracked and closed.

Establish programme governance and maintain visibility of schedule, risks, issues, dependencies and milestone health, proactively escalating where intervention or decisions are required.

Coordinate across multiple technical and operational workstreams, including Data Center Operations, engineering, networking, physical infrastructure, construction/build teams, logistics and third-party partners.Lead through influence in a matrixed regional environment, establishing accountability and driving alignment across stakeholders without relying on direct organisational authority.Identify delivery risks, gaps and emerging constraints early, develop mitigation and recovery plans, and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution.

Partner with site management and external vendors during new-site mobilisation, ensuring deployment and readiness activities are completed safely, consistently and to the required quality.

Use programme data and structured tracking to drive execution, identify overdue or at-risk activities and provide concise programme-health reporting to stakeholders and leadership.

Develop and scale lessons learned, standards, best practices and reusable processes across APAC metros to improve the consistency, quality and speed of future mobilisation activities.

Enable and transfer knowledge to local teams, supporting sustainable operational ownership following mobilisation and transition.

Collaborate with other regions and global teams to align mobilisation practices, tooling and programme standards while adapting execution to regional requirements.Champion safety, security, compliance and quality throughout programme planning and execution.

Model Microsoft culture and values, bringing clarity in ambiguity, generating energy across diverse teams and delivering measurable outcomes.

 **Qualifications**

3+ years of project or programme management experience delivering complex, cross-functional infrastructure, data centre, cloud or critical-environment programmes.

Demonstrated experience leading projects or programmes end-to-end, including planning, milestone management, dependency management, risk mitigation, stakeholder communication and delivery.

Experience working in data centre operations, infrastructure deployment, critical infrastructure or a closely related technical environment.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and priorities in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements.

Strong experience identifying programme risks, resolving blockers and driving recovery actions across multiple stakeholder organisations.

Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority across engineering, operations, vendors and programme stakeholders.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex programme information into clear status, risks, decisions and actions for both technical and leadership audiences.

Working knowledge of data centre technical infrastructure and deployment lifecycles, sufficient to engage effectively with engineering and operational SMEs.Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams.Ability to travel up to 25%, based on programme and site requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with hyperscale data centre mobilisation, new-site onboarding, expansion or transition-to-operations programmes.

Experience delivering large-scale server, network, GPU/AI or other data centre infrastructure deployments.

Experience coordinating construction/build, engineering, operations, supply chain/logistics and external vendors.

Experience with programme governance, dashboards, data analytics or workflow-management tools used to manage distributed programmes.

Demonstrated experience developing standards, lessons learned and continuous-improvement mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.

Familiarity with IT service management / ITIL concepts.Project/programme management certification such as PMP or equivalent.Relevant technical certifications such as CCNA/CCNP are advantageous but not required.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 9017b46f.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Payments
9017b46f.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3 years of experience managing software development projects and working with third-party partners.
* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in the commerce/payments space.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication and organizational skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
* Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
* Define the scope of projects and develop, execute, or manage project plans for supported programs.
* Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. 8e6a5119.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The GSS Data Analytics team serves as Uber's analytics and AI solutions partner, helping Product,  
Operations, Engineering, and Data Science teams solve complex business challenges through  
scalable analytics, automation, and AI-powered solutions.  
As a Program Manager II, you will lead high-impact initiatives from problem definition through  
execution, driving cross-functional alignment while delivering solutions that improve operational  
efficiency, decision-making, and business outcomes across Uber's global lines of business.  
This role sits at the intersection of program management, advanced analytics, automation, and  
emerging AI technologies. You will partner with stakeholders across the company to identify  
opportunities, define success metrics, and build scalable solutions that unlock measurable business  
impact.  
  
**- What You Will Do -**  
  

* Lead end-to-end analytics, automation, and AI initiatives by partnering with Product,

Operations, Engineering, and Data Science teams to define business problems,  
establish success metrics, and drive execution from ideation through implementation.  

* Utilize advanced analytical and visualization techniques to develop scalable

end-to-end solutions, uncover actionable insights from large and complex datasets,  
and influence product, operational, and strategic decisions across Uber.  

* Translate complex analytical findings and technical solutions into clear, concise, and

compelling recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders,  
enabling data-driven decision making at all levels of the organization.  

* Drive multiple concurrent analytics, data engineering, and AI projects while navigating

ambiguity, prioritizing effectively, and maintaining a high bar for quality, accuracy, and  
operational excellence.  

* Design KPI frameworks, measurement strategies, and performance tracking systems

that help teams monitor business health, evaluate initiatives, and identify opportunities  
for growth and efficiency improvements.  
  
Identify opportunities to leverage Machine Learning and Generative AI technologies,  
define solution strategies, translate business requirements into technical  
specifications, and partner with technical teams to deliver impactful AI-powered  
solutions.  

* Build intelligent data products and automation solutions, including conversational

assistants, recommendation systems, self-service tools, and workflow automations by  
leveraging Python, LLM APIs, and modern AI technologies.  

* Lead vendor data analysts and project contributors, establish best practices and

documentation standards, and continuously improve the scalability, efficiency, and  
quality of DAS team deliverables.  

* Cut through noise in large datasets to identify the core business questions,

demonstrate strong attention to detail, and maintain a hands-on, scrappy approach to  
solving problems and unblocking teams when needed.  
  
**- What You Will Need -**  
  

* 6+ years of experience in Program Management, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data

Science, Data Engineering, or related quantitative fields.  

* Advanced SQL and Python proficiency with experience developing analytical,

automation, or AI-driven solutions using large-scale datasets.  

* Experience leading cross-functional programs and partnering with Product,

Operations, Engineering, and Data Science stakeholders to deliver business impact.  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex

business challenges into scalable data, automation, or AI solutions.  

* Experience communicating insights and recommendations to both technical and

non-technical audiences and influencing decisions through data-driven storytelling.  
  
**- Preferred Qualifications -**  
  

* Experience applying Machine Learning, Generative AI, or advanced analytics

techniques to solve business problems and drive measurable outcomes.  

* Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI services

through APIs to build intelligent applications, copilots, chatbots, or workflow  
automation solutions.

recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, decision-support systems, or  
self-service analytics platforms.

model evaluation methodologies, and deployment considerations.

and driving alignment across multiple teams and organizations.

Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

0d62aae7.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Strategic programs, PRISM, Last Mile Delivery Tech
0d62aae7.description:
**Description**
How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
  
  
If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Speed is one of the most customer-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
  
  
As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the single-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross-functional teams, making trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done

The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra-large projects, and a well-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and make trade-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
  
  
**About The Team**
PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 4+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 3+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. 52297708.description:
**About Team**
Walmart Global Tech team enables our stores and eCommerce operations across the world. The platforms that we build are used in most of the markets where Walmart has its presence. Global Marketplace team focuses on building Seller Platforms and interfaces which enables sellers across multiple countries to sell and generate business on eCommerce platforms.
  
  
We're looking for highly skilled and experienced Principal Technical Program Manager with a breadth of skills who can create and execute a plan for new strategic initiatives as well as driving the global technology platforms across Global Tech. You should be able to drive high level design, solutioning & delivery of program with our next generation platforms keeping scalability, robustness and security aspects in focus. The platforms we build will be used by customers & sellers across multiple countries with each of them being a multi billion dollar business for Walmart. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with passionate software developers, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you. As our business continues to expand into new opportunities and evolve with innovations in supply chain and customer experience, we have an exciting opportunity to build software that scales our operations, leads the industry through innovation, and delights millions of customers worldwide. We leverage cutting-edge technologies such as big data, machine learning, AI, real-time analytics, and high-volume, low-latency, high-availability services to achieve these goals.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a part of the Marketplace Program Management team you will impact the shopping of our customers to build solutions that will enable a seamless, highly scalable omni-channel experience for a multi-billion dollar enterprise. You impact the Walmart business directly in driving technology strategies to enable the sellers with the best user experience to onboard, list items and sell and grow their business by selling on Walmart eComm platforms. You may have to travel to the United States and other international locations, working closely with Business Stakeholders, World Class Product Teams, and fellow globally based engineering teams, bridging the gap between business and technology worlds.
  
  
Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development programs. You will work closely with architects, engineers, product, design and business leaders to ensure the successful completion of these programs' To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and software design principles. You will also need to demonstrate influential skills by building strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and programs project cadences. Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints. Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in. You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process. Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise. Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  

* Drive quarterly planning efforts, effectively negotiate against priorities, resources, and timelines to secure commitments from partner teams.
* Create the environment for effective collaboration across 4ITB by establishing appropriate forums and enabling Ways of Working improvements.
* Establish processes that drive efficient planning and execution.
* Work with product and engineering in solutioning of new capabilities, driving clarity in product requirements.
* Create a detailed program plan with milestones and timelines and maintain program documentation.
* Resolve ambiguous situations and bring clarity to the program teams.
* Manage program scope, including changes and scope creep ensuring that the program stays aligned with its original scope.
* Monitor program progress against the established schedule and provide weekly status reports to the program stakeholders.
* Proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation plan and manage cross-functional issues to unblock program team.
* Ensure monitoring and alerting are set up and ensure effective operational excellence frameworks are implemented.
* Ensure that the program adheres to the organization’s standards, policies, and best practices.

**What You'll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computerscience/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall 15+ years of technical experience with 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts,architecture,UXdesign, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, projectmanagement tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, BigPicture, GenAI etc.would be advantageous.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
* Project Management Certification.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing diversity- unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people

c9077a01.title: Identity Architect
c9077a01.description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

88806624.description:
Date: 10/13/26

Description:

**Company Description**

We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

CRG Comment: All available pool has been validated before hiring initiation. Team will continue to run match against external flagged demand, and will keep proposing internal pool as available. Marking this demand for hiring as there is no one available as matching profile internally

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**

71b2e85a.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
71b2e85a.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.
