031f87ce.description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The position is integral to the on-going technical solution deployment and technical application support of professional services (PS) capabilities. This includes five key areas:
  
  

* Demonstrates product expertise in most Genesys Cloud products
* Provides top quality service engagements for large or strategic customers or other accounts serving as the lead technical architect, advisor and/or engineer.
* Follows PS implementation standards
* Assesses complex project situations to make appropriate recommendations to both Genesys and the customer
* Initiates and suggests process improvements to Project Managers and other Management to increase efficiencies for delivery of Genesys Cloud solutions

**Major Responsibilities/Activities**
The Genesys Cloud Implementation consultant is responsible for delivering Genesys Cloud solutions for customers or Partners. This position is responsible for developing a high level of expertise across the majority of Genesys products.
  
  
**Solution Deployment**

* Works in close concert with Project Manager in successfully delivering projects.
* Delivers technical implementation activities from post-sale to support transition for PS engagements as required for key customers and to load balance with the rest of the team
* Follows PSO implementation standards
* Delivers post-GoLive production support activities and customer environment management (Operational Support Management/OSM)
* Execution of project plan tasks associated with engagements
* Test plan validation in close collaboration with Quality Assurance team
* Regular communication of project status
* Provides onsite/remote support for customer escalations as needed
* Maintains on average of 70+% utilization for billable projects
* Identifies engagement-related problem areas and solves the issues in a proactive manner
* Assists the Customer Care organization in performing service call/maintenance activities as required
* Provide technical training to internal or external resources as needed
* Maintains friendly and professional attitude in stressful situations

**Administration**

* Maintains accurate and timely submission of timesheets, expense reports, and project-related forms
* Maintains regular internal communications with project team, team lead, and manager.
* Provides feedback and updates to internal process through internal documentation
* Follows standard department processes.

**Training**

* Continues to stay abreast of new Genesys product releases through internal training, shadowing or experienced consultants, lab development, and industry standards training/certifications

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in a Telecommunication/Computer Engineering/Computer Science, Computer Technology/or related discipline or equivalent professional technical experience
* 2+ years of related experience
* Prior experience with Genesys Cloud Implementation and/or Administration is highly desirable but not a requirement
* Good technical problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate in troubleshooting challenging configurations.
* Flexibility to work across different time zones specifically North America
* Flexibility to take up a operational service management role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of HTTP requests, REST web services, and JSON
* IP Telephony & Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)
* Software Development experience in Java and C#.NET, Python, PHP, web application development scripting, tools and methods is a BIG Plus
* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7
* Knowledge on Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a bonus

**Business Skills**

* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.
* Prior experience in working in a customer facing role
* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.
* Exercises good judgment
* Strong follow-through, ownership & responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

7a004abc.description:
**Your Job**

The Koch Technology team is seeking an SAP Delivery Manager - EWM and Supply Chain to provide people, functional and delivery leadership across SAP Extended Warehouse Management and adjacent supply-chain capabilities. In this role, you will partner with global business and technology leaders to strengthen critical warehouse, manufacturing and planning operations, while developing talent and advancing scalable enterprise solutions.

e122a62b.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
An AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.
  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.
  
  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.
  
  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.
  
  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.
  
  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.
  
  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.
  
  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.
  
  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.
  
  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.
  
  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.
  
  
Experiences
  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.
  
  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.
  
  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.
  
  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.
  
  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.
  
  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.
  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills
  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).
  
  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.
  
  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.
  
  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ab5faa02.description:
Solutions Manager

Bhubaneshwar, Odisha

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a highly technical, rigorous Commissioning Lead to direct and execute end-to-end Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning (Cx) processes for our ultra-high-density AI data center portfolio.

You will be responsible for validating that all electrical power trains, heavy mechanical systems, and complex direct-to-chip liquid cooling networks perform flawlessly under full operational and fault loads. This role ensures our facilities are fully certified and ready to support 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments without downtime risks.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. High-Density Liquid Cooling & MEP Commissioning (L1–L5)

Level 1 to Level 3 Validation: Oversee factory acceptance testing (FAT), equipment receipt inspection, static installation checks, and pre-functional component testing for CDUs, chillers, dry coolers, UPS systems, and generators.

Level 4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT): Lead functional testing of primary and secondary liquid cooling loops, flow rate balancing, pressure differential controls, dynamic fluid quality testing, and electrical load transfers.

Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST): Design and execute full-scale failure mode scenarios, synthetic heat load bank testing at 100 kW–150 kW+ per rack, utility power loss simulations, and emergency cooling switchovers.

2. AI Workload & Thermal Validation

Hydronic & Fluid Quality Certification: Validate pipe flushing, hydro-testing, deionized water chemical treatment, micro-filtration, and automatic leak detection shutdown sequences prior to GPU cluster deployment.

Thermal & Power Density Verification: Verify that environmental controls, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and heat rejection systems maintain required thermal envelopes under maximum synthetic GPU compute loads.

3. Commissioning Governance & Stakeholder Management

Cx Scripts & Protocols: Author, review, and approve custom Level 1–5 commissioning scripts, IST test procedures, matrix load plans, and operating manuals (MOPs/SOPs/EOPs).

Third-Party & Vendor Coordination: Direct third-party commissioning agents (CxA), OEM field engineers, MEP execution leads, and hyperscale client technical representatives.

Issues Tracking & Handover: Manage the Cx issue log (punch list), drive root-cause failure analysis, enforce vendor remediation, and formally sign off on facility operational readiness.

**Job Summary**

Serves as the technical authority for Salesforce and CPQ-CLM within Commercial Operations. You will lead CRM integration work, manage the Service Jira integration, and support the Sales organization with day-to-day Salesforce issues. You will work alongside the existing Salesforce Architect, the Commercial Operations leaders and the Sales Analysts, and will be the main technical contact within Commercial Operations. **PLEASE NOTE:** This role is expected to operate during NAM EST business hours.

* Own the Salesforce architecture: data model, security, automation, and release strategy.
* Lead CRM integration initiatives with other enterprise systems, including integration patterns, APIs, and error handling.
* Manage and evolve the Service Jira integration: workflows, field mapping, sync monitoring, and issue resolution.
* Design, configure, and optimize Salesforce CPQ and CLM: product and pricing rules, approvals, quote templates, and contract lifecycle.

* Turn business requirements from Commercial Operations into scalable solutions, with effort estimates.

* Coordinate handoffs with the other Salesforce Architect, so work continues across time zones with clear documentation and status updates.
* Review the work of admins and developers, and mentor peers on best practices.
* Support Deephealth leadership especially Commercial and Operations leadership with recommendation and solutions to business requirements managed through CRM.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of Salesforce experience, including 5+ years in an architect or lead technical role.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Enterprise Setup and Architecture Design. Knowledge of CPQ-CLM is a plus.
* Experience with integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft or Workato), including Jira.
* Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or CPQ Specialist certifications.
* Strong skills in Apex, Flow, LWC, and declarative configuration.
* Understanding of lead-to-cash, quoting, and contract management.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical users.
* Excellent written and verbal English, and comfort working independently in a remote, cross-time-zone team.
* Willingness to work US Eastern hours and to support critical releases or quarter-end periods outside the core window.
* Authorization to work in India.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Service Cloud and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).
* Experience supporting US-based business teams from an offshore location.

**Quality Standards**

* Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
* Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
* Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
* Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
* Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
* Practices universal safety precautions.
* Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
* Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
* Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Remote

Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the maintenance and enhancement of Kubernetes clusters to ensure exceptional cloud service performance and reliability, using automation and collaboration to solve technical challenges and support critical deployments.
  
  

* Maintain and upgrade Kubernetes clusters to ensure stability and performance.
* Monitor cluster health, resource utilization, and system metrics to proactively address issues.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications in cloud environments using best practices.
* Troubleshoot containers, networking, and service issues to minimize downtime.
* Participate in incident response and contribute to on-call activities as required.
* Document configurations, processes, and operational procedures clearly for team use.
* Collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to support deployment and reliability efforts.
* Automate routine operational tasks through scripting and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.

**About You**
You bring hands-on experience with container technologies like Docker and Podman and have managed Kubernetes/OpenShift or similar platforms. Proficient in Linux system administration and familiar with server infrastructure and networking concepts, you apply scripting skills to automate environments. Your background includes managing high-availability systems and disaster recovery scenarios, complemented by knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and cloud security best practices.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Proven experience utilizing Docker and Podman technologies for container management.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing Kubernetes, OpenShift, or Rancher clusters, including upgrading and monitoring.
* Strong Linux system administration skills with hands-on mastery of OpenStack and KVM virtualization.
* Comprehensive understanding of server infrastructure components from providers like HPE and Dell.
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts such as VPNs, DNS, load balancing, routing, and firewall configuration.
* Experience with scripting languages such as Bash and Python to automate infrastructure tasks.
* Familiarity with high-availability setups and disaster recovery planning within cloud environments.
* Experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code tools, favoring Terraform, to provision and manage resources.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and delivery activities.
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles and cloud security best practices.
* Proficient in Git version control for managing code and configuration artifacts.
* Familiarity with virtualization platforms such as Proxmox and Nutanix enhances operational flexibility.
* Knowledge of VMware environments adds value to virtualization and cloud operations capabilities.
* Competent in monitoring toolsets including Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack to track system performance and troubleshoot issues.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD), RHCSA, RHCE, or LFCS are desirable.

**Your soft skills:**

* Demonstrates effective collaboration with cross-functional teams to achieve operational goals.
* Communicates technical information clearly and professionally to diverse audiences.
* Exhibits persistence in addressing technical challenges and delivering consistent outcomes.
* Manages time efficiently to handle tasks with shifting priorities and defined deadlines.
* Approaches problem-solving with a methodical and solution-oriented mindset.

Join Orange as a Consultant - Cloud Operations and contribute to building resilient, innovative cloud environments that drive the company’s digital transformation. In this role, you will engage in challenging projects that leverage your technical expertise and adaptability, while working within a collaborative and supportive environment focused on professional growth and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

a5c92938.description:
Position Summary

The Manager, Cloud Infrastructure Support is responsible for leading a team of Cloud Administrators and Cloud Engineers delivering Day 2 managed services across public cloud platforms. This role provides operational leadership, workforce management, customer escalation support, performance coaching, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure exceptional service delivery, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. The manager is accountable for team health, business performance, strategic execution, and alignment with Cloud Infrastructure Support (CIS) objectives.

  

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

* Lead a team of Cloud Administrators and Cloud Engineers providing 24x7 public cloud support services.

* Ensure adherence to service level objectives (SLOs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and operational processes.

* Monitor ticket queues, workload distribution, support coverage, backlog health, and customer impact.

* Drive rapid response and resolution of customer escalations, major incidents, and business-critical events.

Coordinate with Incident Management teams, platform vendors, and cross-functional teams during high-severity incidents.  

  

People Leadership

* Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing technical talent.

* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching sessions, goal reviews, and performance discussions.

* Mentor team members on technical, operational, and customer-facing competencies.

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer obsession, and continuous learning.

Support employee career growth and succession planning.  

  

Service Delivery & Customer Success

* Partner with customer-facing stakeholders to support strategic accounts and address service concerns.

Support initiatives that improve efficiency, customer outcomes, and business growth.

Contribute to strategic planning, workforce planning, organizational initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration efforts.  



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 15+ years of total Experience with 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, systems administration, managed services, or technical support environments.
* 2+ years of people leadership experience managing technical teams.

* Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.

* Experience managing customer escalations and service delivery operations.

* Strong analytical, communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Fluent English communication skills; Spanish proficiency required.  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Public cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. **Become our next FutureStarter**
---------------------------------

Are you ready to make an impact? ZF is looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a FutureStarter, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of mobility. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!

**Senior Solution Architect**
=============================

Country/Region: IN

Location:
Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032

Req ID 91772 | Hyderabad, India, ZF India Pvt. Ltd.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Team**

Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence.

We are looking for architects who can translate complex automotive and engineering challenges into scalable AI, cloud, and software architecture, and help take solutions from research and proof of concept to production across global engineering teams.

  

**What you can look forward to as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)**

* **End-to-end ownership:** You'll own the technical architecture of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, from framing the business problem through to secure, observable and cost-efficient production systems.
* **Real-world impact:** You'll turn LLM capabilities into reliable, auditable solutions that hold up against complex enterprise data, strict security and compliance requirements, tight latency and cost budgets, and unpredictable model behavior. This role goes well beyond proof of concept.
* **Architecture leadership:** You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on.
* **Strategic decisions:** You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence.
* **Cutting-edge technology:** You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry.
* **Visibility and influence:** You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.
  

**Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or a related field.
* 10+ years in software, data or ML engineering, including at least 3 years as a solution or lead architect.
* **Production GenAI delivery:** You have delivered at least 2–3 LLM / Generative AI solutions into production, not only proofs of concept, and owned the architecture and non-functional requirements end to end.
* **Agentic AI:** You have built hands-on agentic systems hands-on, with tool use, state management and human-in-the-loop controls. You've used code-first frameworks such as LangGraph / LangChain or managed platforms such as AWS Bedrock Agents or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service.
* **LLM and model expertise:** You have a strong grasp of LLM fundamentals (transformers, embeddings, context windows). You have hands-on experience customising models through fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA / QLoRA) and evaluating them, and you can choose sensibly between prompting, RAG and training.
* **Engineering and cloud:** You are an expert in Python and API engineering (FastAPI, async, event-driven design). You have strong architecture experience on at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure or GCP), including networking, identity and security.
* **RAG, quality and security:** You have practical experience with vector databases, hybrid search and retrieval evaluation. You've implemented LLM evaluation, tracing and observability in production, and you're well-grounded in AI security (prompt-injection defence, data protection).

**Why you should choose ZF in India**

* **Innovative Environment**: ZF is at the forefront of technological advancements, offering a dynamic and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and growth.
* **Diverse and Inclusive Culture**: ZF fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected, promoting a culture of collaboration and mutual support.
* **Career Development**: ZF is committed to the professional growth of its employees, offering extensive training programs, career development opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.

As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. **Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated AI Architect ready to take us to the next level! If you have lead the design, strategy, and implementation of cutting-edge AI/ML platforms and solutions and are looking for your next career move, apply now.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an **AI Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and implementation of cutting-edge AI/ML platforms and solutions. This position will be **full-time** and **remote**.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define technical vision and architecture for conversational AI platforms, AI governance systems, and domain-specific agentic solutions

* Establish architectural standards for LLM integration (Claude, OpenAI), RAG systems, vector databases, and AI orchestration
* Drive technology selection for frontend (React/Angular), backend (FastAPI, Node.js), databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch), and AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex)
* Design AI governance frameworks including usage tracking, cost optimization, access control (RBAC/ABAC), and compliance enforcement (SOC 2, GDPR)
* Architect API security patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS), data encryption, and audit logging for AI platforms
* Define multi-tenancy architecture for SaaS-based AI solutions with role-based access and data isolation
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams (backend, frontend, AI/ML, DevOps) across India CoE and Singapore
* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, and guide implementation decisions for high-impact GenAI projects
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership to align technical architecture with business objectives
* Mentor architects and senior engineers on cloud-native design, AI/ML best practices, and enterprise integration patterns
* Design MLOps pipelines for AI model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and A/B testing
* Architect enterprise integrations with APIs, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and legacy systems using event-driven patterns
* Define observability and monitoring strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and CloudWatch

  

**What You'll Need**

Required:

* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture with 5+ years designing AI/ML platforms or GenAI solutions
* Deep expertise in cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure), microservices, API design, and distributed systems
* Strong knowledge of GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG systems, vector databases, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks)
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale platforms serving 10,000+ users with high availability and security requirements
* Expert-level knowledge of backend frameworks (FastAPI, Node.js, Django), frontend frameworks (React, Angular), and database systems (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases)
* Strong understanding of AI/ML frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face), model serving (TensorFlow Serving, Triton), and MLOps practices
* Proficiency in API management (MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong), event-driven architectures, and message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Deep knowledge of security (OAuth 2.0, JWT, encryption, OWASP), compliance (SOC 2, GDPR), and data privacy
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence technical decisions, and drive architectural alignment
* Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex architectures to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience managing vendor relationships, technology partnerships, and third-party integrations
* Strong decision-making abilities based on data-driven insights, trade-off analysis, and business impact

  

Preferred:

* Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent
* Experience with AI governance platforms, prompt management systems, and LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Weights & Biases)

* Prior experience in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial domains is a plus

f9704209.title: Data Architect & AI Engineering Lead, Cybersecurity - Assistant Vice President
f9704209.description:
**Who we are looking for**
==========================

**The Data Engineer / Data Scientist, Assistant Vice President, will provide technical and strategic leadership for enterprise cybersecurity data, analytics, and AI capabilities. This role will drive the architecture and delivery of scalable data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI solutions that convert complex security telemetry into actionable intelligence. The AVP will partner with cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, governance, and risk stakeholders to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, operational efficiency, and executive decision-making while establishing scalable engineering and data science practices across the organization**


  
  

**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

As a Data Engineer / Scientist, you will:

* Design and deliver scalable **data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, data models, and analytics-ready datasets** using Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud technologies.

* Build reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, aggregation, data quality, reconciliation, orchestration, lineage, and observability.

* Develop statistical, machine-learning, and AI models to identify **patterns, anomalies, relationships, threats, and risk signals** across cybersecurity datasets.

* Apply **ML, graph analytics, NLP, and Generative AI** to improve threat detection, vulnerability prioritization, incident enrichment, cyber-risk scoring, and security posture insights.

* Develop AI solutions leveraging **LLMs, embeddings, semantic/vector search, RAG, and intelligent workflows** to summarize, classify, correlate, and enrich cybersecurity information.

* Operationalize data science and AI solutions through **feature pipelines, MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, and production workflows** .

* Engineer and analyze high-volume **structured, semi-structured, time-series, graph, and unstructured security data** across cloud and enterprise platforms.

* Build Power BI dashboards and self-service analytical products to communicate **security trends, operational performance, risk insights, and model outcomes** .

* Establish strong engineering and responsible AI practices covering **performance, scalability, resiliency, explainability, security, privacy, lineage, governance, and auditability** .

* Partner with cybersecurity, data and platform engineering, architecture, governance, risk, and product teams to translate complex security challenges into scalable **data and AI solutions** .

* Evaluate emerging **data engineering, ML, GenAI, graph, cloud, SIEM/SOAR, and cybersecurity technologies** and drive their practical adoption.

  

**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong technical expertise across **Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI/GenAI.**

* Deep understanding of **Lakehouse architectures, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, orchestration, and pipeline optimization** .

* Hands-on expertise with **Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, and cloud data platforms.**

* Experience with **statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, supervised and unsupervised learning, experimentation, and model evaluation.**

* Practical knowledge of **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, NLP, graph analytics, and responsible AI practices.**

* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts including **security telemetry, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity risk, threat intelligence, incidents, and SIEM/SOAR workflows.**

* Ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architecture and engineering decisions, and communicate effectively with **technical teams and senior stakeholders** .

* Strong focus on **automation, reusable engineering patterns, operational excellence, governance, and measurable business outcomes.**

**Education & Qualifications**
==============================

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 15 to 20 years of professional experience across **data engineering, data science, analytics, cloud, machine learning, AI, or related technology disciplines.**

* Experience applying data engineering, analytics, ML, or AI techniques to **cybersecurity, risk, fraud, identity, infrastructure, or other large-scale enterprise datasets.**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

* Strong hands-on experience **with Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, and large-scale data engineering.**

* Experience with **Lakehouse/data platform architecture, data pipelines, modeling, data quality, monitoring, lineage, and performance optimization** .

* Working knowledge of **AWS or comparable cloud data and analytics environments** .

* Experience operationalizing analytical and ML solutions using **CI/CD, version control, testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices** .

* Experience with **Power BI or equivalent visualization technologies.**

* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or advanced coursework in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.

* Experience with **Databricks/Delta Lake and Medallion architecture patterns** .

* Experience with **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or AI-assisted workflows** .

* Experience developing production-grade **ML/AI pipelines, model monitoring, feature pipelines, APIs, or MLOps solutions.**

* Experience working with cybersecurity datasets such as **endpoint telemetry, authentication events, cloud security logs, vulnerability data, asset inventories, network events, incidents, SIEM data, and threat intelligence.**

* Experience in **financial services, regulated industries, or enterprise environments** with strong security, privacy, governance, and audit requirements.

* Relevant **Security+, CySA+, GIAC, CISSP, AWS, Databricks, Data Engineering, ML/AI, or cybersecurity certifications** are advantageous.

  
  

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Data Engineering**

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, ETL/ELT, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, data modeling, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability

**Data Science / ML**

Statistical modeling, feature engineering, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, experimentation, model evaluation and explainability.

**AI & Gen AI**

LLMs, NLP, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows.

**Cloud & DevOps**

AWS, cloud data services, CI/CD, Git, automated testing, scalable processing and MLOps.

**Cybersecurity Analytics**

SIEM/SOAR workflows, alert enrichment, cyber telemetry, vulnerability data, identity risk, incident and response datasets.

**Visualization & BI**

Power BI dashboards, operational metrics, executive-ready reporting, trend analysis, self-service analytical products.

  
  

**Additional Requirements**
===========================

* This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration expectations.

* The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

* The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**
====================================

**Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. This role will bridge Data Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and AI, building trusted data foundations and intelligent solutions that improve threat detection, risk prioritization, security operations, and enterprise decision-making.**


  
  

**About State Street**

State Street is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, investment management, investment research, and trading. Technology and cybersecurity are critical enablers of our ability to safeguard information, support clients, and operate at enterprise scale.

We value collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and responsible technology. We are looking for technical talent who can solve meaningful problems, communicate clearly, and help build secure, scalable, data-driven capabilities for the future.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

  
  

**About State Street**

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

d70d01ae.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
**Your Role**
We are seeking an experienced Vertex AI Engineer and Cloud Delivery Lead to drive the design, deployment, and operationalisation of machine learning solutions on Google Cloud. This role bridges AI/ML engineering and cloud delivery, ensuring that models and pipelines reach production reliably, securely, and at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement end-to-end MLOps pipelines on Vertex AI, including data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and deployment
* Build and manage Vertex AI Pipelines (Kubeflow Pipelines) for automated model training and retraining workflows
* Deploy and manage models using Vertex AI Model Registry, Endpoints, and Batch Prediction services
* Implement feature engineering workflows using Vertex AI Feature Store
* Develop GCP-native integrations connecting Vertex AI with BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub
* Manage infrastructure for ML workloads using Terraform, ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments
* Configure IAM policies for Vertex AI workloads including service account governance and VPC Service Controls
* Lead cloud delivery activities: sprint planning, release management, environment promotion, and stakeholder communication
* Establish model monitoring using Vertex AI Model Monitoring for data drift and skew detection
* Collaborate with data scientists to containerise experiments and promote models through dev/staging/production
* Drive adoption of GKE for model serving workloads where custom inference infrastructure is required

**Your Profile**

* Total Years of Experinece Min.12 Years
* 4+ years of experience with GCP, including 2+ years hands-on with Vertex AI
* Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
* Experience building Vertex AI Pipelines and managing model lifecycle in Vertex AI Model Registry
* Solid Terraform skills for provisioning Vertex AI, GCS, BigQuery, and associated infrastructure
* Good understanding of GCP IAM, particularly for securing ML pipelines and data access
* Experience with GCP-native development patterns and event-driven architectures
* Demonstrated cloud delivery experience including planning, execution, and stakeholder management
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and GKE for model serving

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
  
  
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection*.*

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* *If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.* *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

This role will serve as a key connector between site leadership, employees, functional teams, compliance, employee relations, external partners, and cross-site/global stakeholders. Build strong, positive relationships and communication channels with employees across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* **8+ years of experience in site strategy, business operations, program management, site operations, or a related field.**

* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

* Strong understanding of employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, and workplace operations.

WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. 622ae612.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
622ae612.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technical Program ManagerAn AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.  
  
Experiences  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

39cf54b0.description:
**About Globeia**

Globeia is a bootstrapped global identity verification and document services company, serving clients across multiple countries. We are building a technology platform that turns a manual, paperwork-heavy industry into a software-driven experience. Our Gurugram office is the global hub where tech, design, QA and operations sit together.

**About the Role**

Our CEO is based in Washington DC. Our build team is in Gurugram. We need one person on the ground in Gurugram who owns delivery: someone who knows what every team is working on, what is due when, what is slipping, and why.

This is a program management role, not a product management role. You will not decide what we build. You will make sure that what we have committed to build ships on time, and that tech, design, QA and operations are working in step rather than waiting on each other.

**What You Will Do**

* Own delivery timelines across tech, design, QA and operations, with the product roadmap as your first priority.
* Turn the roadmap into clear plans with milestones, owners and dates, and keep those plans current.
* Run the delivery rhythm: sprint planning, standups, reviews and cross-team check-ins.
* Spot dependencies and blockers early, and resolve them before they cost us a deadline.
* Pressure-test estimates from engineering and design so the dates we commit to are realistic.
* Give the CEO a clear, honest weekly picture of what shipped, what is at risk and what needs a decision.
* Act as the bridge between the CEO and the Gurugram teams, so priorities are understood and nothing is lost across time zones.
* Build the tracking systems, dashboards and processes that keep the office running efficiently as we grow.
* Hold teams accountable to their commitments, and raise problems early rather than late.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 8 years of experience, with at least 2 years in technical program management, engineering project management or delivery management at a software company.
* A technical background: a degree in engineering or computer science, or earlier hands-on experience as a developer or QA engineer. You don't need to write code, but you do need to understand how software gets built.
* A track record of shipping products on schedule across engineering, design and QA.
* Strong working knowledge of agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Linear or ClickUp.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication. You can summarize a messy situation in five lines.
* Comfort holding senior people accountable, including people who do not report to you.
* Experience working with a remote founder or leadership team across time zones is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is preferred. We are bootstrapped, we move fast, and there is no layer of management to hide behind.

**Why Join Us**

* You report directly to the founder and CEO.
* You are the person responsible for delivery in our largest office, with real authority to match.
* You will help build a product from scratch.
* There is room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.

**Location and Hours**

This is a full time, on-site role in Gurugram. Some overlap with US Eastern time is expected for regular syncs with the CEO.

16600c8c.title: Consultant _FinTech Product & Solutions
16600c8c.description:
You will build and ship production iOS apps for a large Indian banking client, where security, performance and release discipline matter more than in a typical consumer app. You will own features end-to-end in Swift UI, data flow, networking, persistence and App Store release — and be a core part of GeekyAnts' native iOS practice. This is a native-first role, but we are building a mobile team that can flex. Over time you may work on React Native or Flutter projects alongside Swift, with support from our existing teams in both. Candidates who want to stay purely in one stack forever will not be the right fit.

**What you will do:**

* Design, build and maintain iOS features in Swift using UIKit and SwiftUI, following MVVM and clean architecture principles
* Implement secure networking (URLSession, SSL pinning, Codable) and data persistence (Core Data, Realm, SwiftData, UserDefaults) for a banking-grade app
* Write concurrent, responsive code using GCD, OperationQueue, async/await and Combine
* Own quality: unit tests with XCTest, profiling with Instruments, crash triage and fixes
* Handle code signing, provisioning, App Store Connect submissions and release management
* Review code, mentor SE1–SE3 engineers and raise the bar on iOS standards across the team
* Work with the client's product, backend and security teams; translate requirements into technical designs and estimates
* Contribute to presales solutioning (architecture inputs, effort estimates) when needed
* Be open to picking up React Native or Flutter work when project demand shifts

**Must-have skills:**

* 4+ years of hands-on iOS development with at least 2 apps shipped to the App Store.
* Swift & Xcode- Strong Swift (protocols, generics, optionals, value vs reference types), Xcode project structure, UIViewController lifecycle, working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code
* UI — UIKit- Storyboards, Auto Layout, UITableView, UICollectionView, custom views, navigation and modal flows
* UI — SwiftUI- Views, modifiers, stacks, NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, sheets and modals; can mix SwiftUI with UIKit
* Concurrency- GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Task, structured concurrency, thread-safety and main-thread discipline
* State & architecture- @State, @Binding, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject, MVVM, dependency injection (Needle, Swinject or similar)
* Reactive & networking- Combine (publishers, operators, cancellables), URLSession, Codable, SSL/certificate pinning, API error handling
* Persistence- UserDefaults, Core Data; exposure to Realm and SwiftData
* Quality & debugging- Xcode debugger, Instruments (Time Profiler, Leaks, Allocations), crash log symbolication, XCTest unit and UI tests
* Release- Code signing, provisioning profiles, App Store Connect, TestFlight, phased releases

**Good to have:**

* Working exposure to React Native or Flutter, or a demonstrated willingness to learn one
* BFSI / fintech experience: PCI-DSS or RBI-aware development, Keychain, jailbreak and tamper detection, secure storage, biometric auth
* CI/CD for iOS (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Modular architecture (Swift Package Manager, feature modules), Clean Architecture or VIPER
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type) and localisation
* Experience working in a client-facing or consulting setup

**Who you are:**

* You care about how the app behaves on a slow network and an old iPhone, not just on the simulator
* You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical client stakeholder without hiding behind jargon
* You are comfortable owning a feature from estimate to App Store release, not only the coding part
* You are curious about the wider mobile ecosystem and willing to work across stacks when the business needs it
* You give and take code review feedback well and help junior engineers grow

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT is preferred.
* Candidates with a relevant MCA or equivalent qualification may also be considered.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on AI Solution Architect who can act as the technical face of Antino’s AI practice with enterprise clients and also build what is proposed.

You will lead technical discovery and pre-sales discussions, understand business challenges, design AI/GenAI/Agentic AI solutions, estimate effort, explain trade-offs and risks, and work closely with clients, sales, engineering, and data science teams.

You will build POCs, run demos, write code, define architecture, review production systems, and guide solutions from POC to production.

**Key Responsibilities**

Pre-Sales & Client Solutioning

Lead technical discovery calls, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proposals, SOWs, estimates, and ROI discussions.

Translate business problems into practical AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.

Present solutions and technical trade-offs to CXOs, architects, security, data, and engineering teams.

Build rapid POCs and demos to validate and de-risk solutions.

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Design scalable AI architectures using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, vector databases, embeddings, prompt/context engineering, and knowledge graphs.

Select the right approach across classical ML, LLMs, fine-tuning, RAG, agents, or hybrid solutions.

Build and deploy solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Design APIs, data pipelines, model serving, enterprise integrations, and microservices.

Build production-grade agentic systems including tool calling, multi-agent workflows, memory, human-in-the-loop, and agent hand-offs.

Establish best practices for security, scalability, performance, observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost optimisation.

AI Engineering & Team Enablement

Stay hands-on with Python, FastAPI, AI frameworks, LLM platforms, and cloud technologies.

Guide engineering and data science teams from POC through production.

Implement AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and LLMOps practices.

Train internal teams and create reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and playbooks.

Track emerging AI models, frameworks, protocols, and research and apply relevant innovations to Antino’s AI practice.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

5+ years in software engineering, data science, ML engineering, or solution architecture.

2+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions in production.

Strong experience building Agentic AI, including tool-calling agents, multi-agent systems, agentic RAG, memory, and orchestration.

Strong foundations in statistics, classical ML, deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and time series.

Strong hands-on Python and API development, preferably FastAPI.

Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and open-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.

Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or Google ADK.

Experience with vector/search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

Strong knowledge of Advanced RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, re-ranking, query rewriting, multimodal RAG, and context engineering.

Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, evaluation, and cost optimisation.

Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, databases, APIs, and secure enterprise architecture.

Strong client-facing and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both CXOs and engineering teams.

Advanced AI Expertise

**Strong understanding of:**

Agent Design: Tool/function calling, ReAct, planning, reflection, memory, state management, HITL, failure recovery.

Multi-Agent Systems: Supervisor, hierarchical and peer-to-peer patterns, task routing and agent hand-offs.

Agent Protocols: MCP and A2A.

RAG: Hybrid search, re-ranking, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, agentic/multimodal RAG, permission-aware retrieval.

Model Adaptation: Reasoning, long-context and multimodal models, SLMs, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning.

Inference: vLLM/TGI, quantisation, prompt caching, model routing, latency and token-cost optimisation.

Evaluation: Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, golden datasets, LLM-as-a-Judge, tracing.

AI Security & Governance: Prompt injection defence, guardrails, PII protection, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, and India’s DPDP Act.

**Good to Have**

Experience in IT services/consulting with global clients across the US, UK, or Middle East.

Experience with enterprise knowledge platforms, knowledge graphs, or Company Brain-style systems.

Production experience in Voice AI, Document AI, or Computer Vision.

Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark.

Domain exposure to BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, or Manufacturing.

AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.

Open-source contributions, research papers, patents, technical blogs, or conference talks.

**About Antino**

Antino is an AI-native technology consulting company helping organisations embed intelligence into the way they operate.

600+ Engineers | 50 AI Specialists | 400 Projects Delivered | 20 Countries Served

With offices across India, the US, UK, and UAE, Antino has developed Company Brain—a governed intelligence layer connecting enterprise knowledge, people, systems, and workflows to enable smarter decisions and coordinated action.

1d0cf13c.title: Events & Engagement Manager
1d0cf13c.description:
**About Masters' Union**

Founded in 2020, Masters Union is a new-age, industry-led university focused on business, technology, engineering, and entrepreneurship. Built around learning by doing, the institution combines academics with real-world projects, startup building, and global exposure, with the ambition of becoming one of the worlds top business schools and multidisciplinary universities over the next two decades.

  

Today, Masters’ Union has nearly 3,500 students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programs, with almost half being experienced professionals. Spread across nearly 5 lakh square feet in Gurgaon and Manesar, the institution houses the PwC Center for Generative AI, a Bloomberg Lab, Gurgaon’s premier maker space, AI and robotics infrastructure, advanced bioengineering workshops, and startup incubation spaces, while also expanding into areas such as bioengineering and genetic engineering.

  

The institution is chaired by Manoj Kohli, former CEO of Bharti Airtel and former Country Head of SoftBank India. Its leadership ecosystem includes Vivek Gambhir, Pankaj Bansal, Sanjiv Bikhchandani, Amitabh Kant, and 30+ other founders, CEOs, investors, and policymakers who contribute to teaching and institution building.

  

Masters’ Union’s flagship postgraduate program has recorded the highest average salary among MBA-equivalent programs in India, with graduates placed at firms such as Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Google, and Microsoft. The institution has also built one of the country’s strongest student startup ecosystems, with 10+ students pitching on Shark Tank India and 20+ students raising external funding for their ventures, alongside several successful creators and internet entrepreneurs.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone who can own high-impact admissions events and student engagement experiences for Masters’ Union. This is not a basic event coordination role. We need someone who can plan, execute, travel, manage vendors, lead a team, coordinate with internal stakeholders, create event pages, manage registrations, and ensure every event directly contributes to admissions outcomes.

The ideal candidate should be operationally strong, comfortable with students and parents, good with timelines, sharp with communication, and able to manage chaos without losing control.

  

**Specifically, this role will involve**

* Planning and executing high-quality admissions events across online and offline formats.
* This includes: Startup Weekends; City meetups; Webinars; Masterclasses; Open houses; Campus visits; Applicant engagement events; Founder sessions; Alumni/student interaction sessions; Conversion-focused events for offered candidates
* Making sure every event feels well-planned, premium, sharp, and aligned with the Masters’ Union brand.
* Owning the full event cycle: Event idea Planning Website page Registrations Communication Execution Attendance Follow-up Reporting
* You will be responsible for: Creating event plans and timelines; Setting up event pages on the website; Managing registration forms
* Sending event communication through email, WhatsApp, and SMS
* Managing student confirmations and reminders
* Coordinating with speakers, faculty, alumni, and internal teams
* Handling venue, food, travel, stay, logistics, and vendor coordination
* Ensuring smooth execution on the day of the event
* Managing a Zoom webinar and a 300-person offline event.
* You will manage online & offline events
* Playing a key role in planning and executing Masters’ Union’s flagship admissions events like Startup Weekends and high-intent applicant experiences.
* This includes: Planning the event format; Coordinating with mentors, founders, faculty, alumni, and students; Managing student participation; Creating team structures and event flows; Handling on-ground execution
* Managing travel and stay for participants, wherever required
* Ensuring the event creates strong engagement and improves admissions conversion
* These events are not just brand-building activities. They are high-impact conversion levers.
* Ensuring all admissions events are correctly listed, updated, and managed on the website.
* This includes: Creating event pages; Updating event details; Managing registration links; Checking page hygiene; Coordinating with website/tech teams; Ensuring correct dates, cities, speakers, forms, and CTAs
* Working with the content and admissions teams to ensure every event has strong communication before and after the event.
* Leading the events execution team and coordinate with multiple internal teams.
* You will work closely with Admissions counsellors, Content team; Design team,Performance marketing team; Website team; Faculty Alumni; Current students; Programme teams
* You should be able to assign responsibilities, track progress, push people for closures, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

  

**Ideal candidate will have**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in events, admissions, outreach, student engagement, operations, marketing, or programme management
* Prior experience managing or leading a team is mandatory
* Strong experience planning and executing online and offline events
* Ability to travel for events across cities
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage vendors, venues, logistics, and internal teams
* Ability to work with WhatsApp, email, CRM, forms, and event platforms
* Experience in education, edtech, admissions, events, or student-facing roles is preferred
* Skill in assigning tasks, track progress, and ensure closures without constant follow-up
* Comfortability speaking to students, parents, speakers, vendors, and internal teams
* Leading a small team and get work done across functions
